text: An employee was loading freight. They went to push the freight while standing on the forks of a forklift. The employee fell off the forks and struck the forks, sustaining broken ribs and a laceration behind an ear.

At Well BJN-25, christmas tree lifting during workover around 11:30 hrs. Wind came up suddenly with rain squall. Tree swinging, tag line man slipped on wet ground, line went from his hand. Tree rotated freely for some seconds. Second rigger caught other line and controlled. Job held till rain stopped. Extra tag line man posted for all weather conditions.

Transformer tilted, oil started leaking from damaged lug pocket. Lowered on sleepers, oil collected in tray. Remaining lugs tested, lift done with sling under body. Old lug condition hidden under paint, paint removed and lugs inspected by maintenance engineer before second attempt.
An employee was walking down a staircase when she tripped and fell, resulting in a [OUTCOME] right ankle and a head [OUTCOME].

Monsoon morning at Kathalguri, crane mats floated on standing water during compressor lift. Mats shifted when crane slewed, one outrigger came off mat edge, crane settled with creak. Load was near ground fortunately, landed softly. Water pumped out by diesel pump, matting relaid on compacted surface, daily mat check during monsoon added to crane checklist. Lift completed after rain stopped, four hours delay accepted without complaint.

An employee was loading a 135-foot boom lift onto a trailer. The unit started to slide and fell off the trailer onto its side, throwing the employee to the ground. The employee sustained a [OUTCOME] and dislocated right shoulder and two [OUTCOME] to their left wrist.
An employee was standing inside a lift when the guardrail broke and the employee fell out of the lift. The employee sustained [OUTCOME] to their ribs and pelvis.

During summer afternoon around 15:10 hrs, contract helper was pouring water over the hot bearing of transfer pump at Kathalguri GCS thinking pump is stopped for the day. Pump was only in remote stop and auto started on dispatch demand. His hand was near the fan guard, water mug flew and hit the wall. He sat down with fright. Nothing happened to hand by God's grace. Remote stop meaning explained again to all contract staff with practical demo.

During DG-2 exhaust duct inspection at Kathalguri GCS on 19.12.2025, around 06:40 hrs, worker inside the hot duct found his tapping signals unanswered. Rigger's spanner fell from boom and hit hard hat of his own supervisor standing inside barricade supervising from below. Helmet shell dented, supervisor only shocked. Helmet saved him. text: During loading of casing pipes at Duliajan central store yard on 03.10.2024, trailer moved forward suddenly while crane was still lowering one joint. Communication gap between driver and rigger found as cause. Engine to remain off during loading, instruction repeated to all transporters through written circular same week.

LOTO incomplete on furnace fuel oil line at Naharkatiya GGS-3. Pump was locked but suction from day tank had gravity head, oil kept dripping into furnace through burner tip. Inspector inside smelled oil and saw fresh oil film near burner. Came out immediately. Day tank outlet valve also locked and blind flange put. Gravity head also is energy.

An employee climbed onto a flatbed trailer to adjust a strap, lost his balance, and fell from the trailer to the ground. He suffered broken ribs.

text: UG sump near Moran power house: opened for pump repair, detector showed low oxygen 17.8 percent though no smell nothing. sludge decomposition in closed sump, invisible. mechanic was already wearing his helmet to go down. stopped at the hatch itself. blower run two hours, retest 20.6, then entry. no smell does not mean no problem.

Oily water separator pit at Jorajan. Worker inside without harness because pit is only chest deep, he argued. But pit floor was oily sludge, he slipped and fell face down in sludge, could not get up quickly in the muck. Standby had no rope to pull, jumped in and lifted him out. Both covered in oily sludge. Depth is not the only criterion for harness.

Mast raising at workover rig #7 after rig move. Raising line snagged on a rung clamp added by the paint crew the previous week, driller pulled a bit more, the clamp snapped and flew off like a stone from a sling, landing near the catwalk where a roustabout stood with pipe. He ducked behind the rack and nothing happened, but that clamp from that height is not something a helmet argues with. Snag walk had been done, yet the clamp was on no drawing and no list, so nobody looked twice. New rule: nothing attaches to mast structure without a work order and a rig file entry, and the snag walk checks against the file instead of memory.

Weekend maintenance at Dumduma, 23.08.2025. The sand conveyor was worked on for three hours with the VFD in bypass and the breaker racked out, but no try start was done after lockout. When grid supply came back after a dip, the auto-restart logic gave a pulse and the belt crept forward with a man's boot still on the idler frame. He rolled off in time. Auto-restart defeated during permit jobs from now on.

text: Around 20:20 hrs at GGS-2, contract helper Jintu was tightening the lantern ring of the condensate pump with pump stopped from the DCS soft stop. Soft stop keeps the control supply live. Operator on the other console pressed hard start for the schedule. Lantern ring tool hit his thumb as shaft moved. Thumb nail blue next morning, work continued after first aid. Soft stop versus isolation difference taught with demo.

Two employees were moving a vertical turbine pump into a shop using a set of jacks. One of the jacks hit a small hole in the concrete, causing the pump to jump and land on one employee's right foot. The foot was crushed and the employee was [OUTCOME].

Under load, threads stripped, bolt came out, pump fell on pallet. Thread identification with gauge, correct bolt used. Technician opened the pilot mixer for cleaning without closing the fuel tapping; the mixer was still fed from a small bypass branch nobody had marked. Gas brushed past his sleeve before he withdrew. Bypass traced, tagged, added to the isolation sheet.

An employee was cutting sausage with a knife when they sustained a laceration to their thumb.

Transformer lift at Baghjan EPS substation. The lifting plan copy in crane cabin was of earlier job, different transformer weight. Operator following old radius limits. HSE compared with permit and found mismatch. Correct plan brought from office. Plan revision control now strict, old copies stamped cancelled and removed from cabins.

Power house sump at Jorajan, ladder inside found with rungs missing at bottom two positions, rusted away in sludge line. electrician almost stepped into gap in dark sump, caught handrail just in time. torch was with him luckily. ladder extended and replaced, permanent light fitting demanded for sump.

Contract technician was replacing the vibrating fork level switch on the surge drum at Kathalguri GCS around 09:40 hrs. Drum was in service, only the switch nozzle valve was closed by hand feel, no lock. Valve was passing and liquid pushed the switch out when the last thread opened. It fell on his boot toe and rolled. Boot took the load, toe safe. He sat quietly for five minutes. Nozzle valve replaced in next shutdown and locking enforced.

An employee was on the back of a box truck, working to maneuver a roto tiller away from the metal tool rack that hangs on the walls of the truck. His left ringer fingertip became pinned/stuck between the metal handle of the roto tiller and the metal tool rack, resulting in [OUTCOME] of the fingertip.

On 06.03.2025 at about 14:15 hrs, crane carrier moving slowly through Balijan village road. One old man on bicycle came from side lane directly in front. Hard braking done. Carrier's hook block swung and hit roadside jhopdi lightly. Driver without seatbelt hit steering wheel, minor pain only. Old man fell on his own but got up and walked away. Could have been much worse for him. Reported to site engineer.

Roof sheet bundle lifting at EPS by crane to pump house roof. Bundle landed partly on roof edge, sheets slid toward edge, one sheet overhanging. Worker went near edge to push it back without clipping. Held him back by shout. Sheet secured by crane again. Never approach load near edge unsecured. Signalman briefing improved for such lifts.

Foggy morning at Digboi, around 06:50 hrs, one electrician entered the transformer pit for a thermography point without gas test. cold dense vapour sat low in the pit. he felt throat irritation and came out. fog also delayed the attendant seeing him go in. double lapse, both addressed.

An employee had dumped a load of hot mix (tar) and was cleaning the interior walls of a belly dump trailer onsite. The employee was scraping the walls of the trailer when the doors articulated, breaking the securement pin and pinching the employee's legs. The employee sustained crushing [OUTCOME] and [OUTCOME] tendons and arteries to both legs and was [OUTCOME].

On 25.11.2024 around 20:40 hrs, night bus overtaking trailer before narrow culvert near Tingrai met oncoming state bus with high beam. our driver blinded, swerved left to soft shoulder after rain. bus tilted, passengers on left window side slid from seats. bus recovered back on road. high beam plus narrow bridge plus rain is worst mix. eye check of drivers also pending.

While returning from EPS around 16:35 hrs, our jeep followed tractor trolley which suddenly reversed few feet to adjust turning at narrow curve. jeep was close behind, almost touched trolley rear beam. no reverse lamp, no helper guiding. jeep driver braked and handbrake pulled. trolley driver did not know vehicle behind at all. horn use also less by our driver accepted.
activity: site vehicle movement on village road

text: Water cooler at Kathaloni shift room was found with the drain pipe cracked and water dripping near the electrical socket. Cooler shifted, pipe replaced and the socket area dried fully. Drip near a socket is a bad combination, explained to the staff. Cooler moved away from the socket wall.

On June 13, 2025, an employee was installing perimeter angle on top of a steel beam. He welded a short piece in place and started installing the next longer piece. He butted the two pieces together, put a weld at the joint and started to move down the angle. As he was moving down the angle, he lost his footing, grabbed the angle, and it broke loose. He then fell backward off the beam and landed on a concrete slab 14 feet below. The employee sustained [OUTCOME] to his upper right arm and a dislocated right elbow.

Drill conducted at Digboi telecom tower on 21.05.2025 with scenario of climber suspended after fall from antenna level with wrongly worn harness. QRT attended. Found during drill that QRT vehicle ladder cannot reach even half of tower height and tower rescue kit training expired for two members. Refresher scheduled and one more trained rescuer added per shift. Drill report sent to Duliajan head office HSE.

Glycol contactor internal inspection at Kathalguri GCS. Entrant and attendant had agreed pull signals but entrant changed position behind baffle where rope angle made pulls weak. His two emergency pulls never reached attendant's hand. When he climbed back near manway on his own, attendant was casually sitting, unaware anything was wrong. Entrant was angry and right. Rope re-routed through pulley at manway so pull direction stays direct from any tray level.

On 18.06.2024 at Kathalguri GCS, grinding close to the crude tank dike going on. Fire blanket spread but it was small size covering only half the spark zone. Spark fell outside blanket on dry grass. Grass caught. Doused. Blanket size to cover full spark zone plus margin, told gang. Two blankets now issued for grinding jobs. Spark zone marking on ground with chalk now done before blanket placement. Good practice photo taken for training.

Grease dropped on the stair step from the bearing job upstairs. Cleaner called immediately and the step scrubbed with sand. Job fellows briefed again that drip tray goes under the work, not beside the work.

Kathalguri GCS DG exhaust duct inspection was carried out on 21.03.2025. Air hose of breathing set had old repair joint, tape wrapped. Inside duct, tape softened from warm surface, joint rotated and kinked hose. Flow choked. Worker felt it early, crawled out fast. Repaired hose condemned on spot, only certified hoses allowed now. Small tape, big choke.
An employee was using a metal pole to hang Christmas lights on a tree outside of a facility. The metal pole touched an electrical line, causing the employee to be shocked and [OUTCOME].

Glycol vessel at Kathalguri GCS, ventilation air mover running, but the duct blew out of the manway collar and lay on platform pumping fresh air to the sky. Inside entrant felt the air go still and warm after some minutes, called up, attendant had assumed venting is ongoing seeing the machine running. Duct refitted with clamp and lanyard. A running machine is not proof of a ventilated vessel; feel the air at the exhaust.
At about 1:20 a.m., on February 1, 2024, an employee was using a circular saw to cut a metal panel for a box. The saw [OUTCOME] the employee's right little finger above the first knuckle.

During night inspection of DG-1 exhaust duct at Kathalguri GCS on 21.11.2025, around 19:45 hrs, the intrinsically safe hand lamp of the M/s Jorhat Engineering helper flickered out deep inside the duct and the spare was inside the locked toolbox of the absent foreman. He waited against the wall and guided himself out along the air line. Lamp-plus-spare check made a signed permit line item; two more EX-rated lamps procured for the GCS.

An employee arrived at a client's home to pick them up. They were walking to the the front door when they slipped on ice and fell on the ground. The employee sustained a [OUTCOME] to their right leg above the knee.

415V panel at Duliajan GGS-2 on 02.04.2025. Feeder MCB replacement in lighting DB. DB main switch OFF but neutral link live from other circuit sharing neutral bar. Wireman touched neutral bar and earth wire together, felt shock through damp shoes. Neutral isolation also now done for DB work, rubber mat kept in front of all lighting DBs.

Scaffold at GGS-2 near the christmas tree of well H: erector used the wellhead handwheel to step up for fixing top clamp. Handwheel can rotate, also it is operational equipment. One turn and his foot goes. Stopped, proper ladder used. Wellhead equipment never to be used as access, told clearly to all erection gangs at Duliajan.

At around 08:10 hrs on 23.01.2025, one HMV carrying drilling material to Baghjan took the shortcut through the school road near Balimara to avoid the highway jam. School gate was just opening and children were coming in groups. HMV driver used pressure horn continuously and children scattered to both sides of the narrow road. One small girl dropped her tiffin and sat down crying. Teachers complained at our gate. HMV movement on school road during school hours completely banned from today, barricade timings fixed.

An employee was working from a ladder attached to cable lines 18 feet above the ground when the cable detached and they fell with the ladder to the ground. They sustained [OUTCOME] to their arm, ribs, and face.

An employee was loading material/equipment onto a track loader bucket. While securing a strap to the equipment, his hand was caught between the track loader bucket teeth and the equipment, resulting in a left finger [OUTCOME].

On July 20, 2025, an employee was descending a fixed ladder when he fell approximately 7 feet to the floor below, landing on his left leg. The employee was [OUTCOME] with a [OUTCOME] left tibia and tears to the posterior cruciate and anterior cruciate ligaments in the left knee.

Contract fitter Dulu was greasing the agitator top bearing at Kathalguri GCS CTF around 16:45 hrs. Agitator stopped locally, no lock, auto on timer. Timer started the agitator and the shaft jerk threw the grease gun from his hand into the tank bund. He held the railing tight. Few inches from the coupling, his sleeve was. Timer schedule changed to manual during any maintenance and lockout applied before touching the bearing.

On 02.12.2025, around 11:25 hrs, at Kathalguri GCS, a M/s Purbanchal Services fitter climbing into DG-3 exhaust duct manway lost footing when his boot sole slipped on a soot film. He caught the manway rim with both hands and hung briefly before colleagues steadied him; tools in his pouch dropped inside the empty duct. Ladder re-seated and tied off, and a three-point-contact reminder given at the morning TBT.

415V panel at Kathalguri on 15.05.2025. Panel incomer busbar PT fuse blown. New fuse inserted with fuse puller but the PT primary side was connected to live bus and fuse clip grip was loose — fuse fell into the live chamber. Puller used again to fish it, puller jaw touched phase to earth. Flash. Chamber isolated and fuse retrieved. Fuse checking now only with chamber dead.

A storage silo imploded due to catastrophic failure and it collapsed, releasing 3,500-3,700 tons of fly ash which struck a 20- x 40-foot shipping container with maintenance supplies. When the silo collapsed, the [OUTCOME] employee was working near the container and was knocked to the ground. The shipping container was pushed onto their right arm, catching it between the container and the ground. The arm sustained an [OUTCOME] that resulted in [OUTCOME].

During a shift change, an employee was showing another employee a potential issue on a conveyor line of potatoes that go out of the warehouse to the trucks. The employee reached under the conveyor with his hand. His finger was pulled into the conveyor sprocket and [OUTCOME].

An employee was on an elevated surface while cutting joints in a bridge deck. The blade on a walk-behind saw was pinched by rebar, causing the employee to fall over the edge to a false decking. The employee fell on a concrete saw, resulting in a lacerated right bicep.

During crude transfer at GGS-2 Naharkatia on 14.10.2024, operator saw pump seal leak increasing drop by drop to thin stream. Pressed e-stop and changed over to standby pump. Seal replaced in two days. Could have become spray near hot surface. Standby pump readiness appreciated. Reported.

On June 14, 2024, two employees were moving a water trailer with a loader and an attachment. The attachment was stuck. The employees used a bar to free it and the loader fell on one employee's left foot, crushing a toe.
contractor: John Burns Construction Company of Texas

text: While doing fuel gas scrubber drain modification at Kathalguri GCS, welder was welding new drain connection. Gas detector showed 20 percent LEL near the weld point because passing inlet valve was leaking gas into scrubber. Welding stopped immediately. Scrubber was not positively isolated, single block valve only. Welding done after blinding.
activity: fuel gas scrubber drain valve maintenance
barrier: single block valve on gas service (no DBB)

text: On July 25, 2025, at 11:21 a.m., an employee was sitting underneath the forks of a forklift while performing maintenance on the forklift when the forks dropped onto them, resulting in a broken femur.

A gap under the fence near rig site KTK-39 mud pump shed was noticed where a porcupine dug through. the hole was repaired with new wire netting on 4 July and patrol rounds doubled for 4 fortnight. wire tension checked again on 4 July 2025. Report sent to installation manager.

N2 purged vessel at Kathalguri GCS. Retrieval line snap hook was gate-type with a worn spring; during trial, hook sprang open when the line twisted, dropping the dummy two feet to the tray, clang echoing inside. Dummy, not a man; everyone exhaled. Self-locking hooks issued, gate-type collected and scrapped. A spring that costs forty rupees was sitting between a man and a two-storey tray fall.

At around 10:05 hrs on 19.01.2025, stairway welding at Kathalguri GCS tank farm. Welder took machine return on the stair grating which was aluminium type grating on steel frame. Aluminium grating is poor conductor for welding current. Arc unstable and grating heated at clamp. Return shifted to steel frame directly. Aluminium looks like steel but behaves different, told welder. Material identification before clamping now emphasized. Grating checked for damage, found okay.
activity: welding repairs on tank farm stairway

text: Slug catcher pit at Digboi, access ladder top rung came off with rust when supervisor grabbed it for balance. he was standing at edge, could have gone in backward 5 metre. grabbed handrail post just in time. ladder bracket fully eaten by condensate drip corrosion. new SS ladder fixed, drip tray also.

At around 22:10 hrs on 30.05.2025, lightning arrestor operated at GGS Balimara substation and supply dipped. UPS carried RTU and wellhead telemetry of four wells without break. Well data logging continued. Could have lost well data for the night. Arrestor checked and found ok. Reported to electrical section.

21.11.2025, around 06:40 hrs: inside DG-3 exhaust duct at Kathalguri GCS, the worker brushed past a hanging soot flap and the M/s Jorhat Engineering worker was enveloped in a black cloud with visibility reduced to nothing. He stayed low, followed the air line back and came out coughing, eyes watering. Shower used and first aider checked him. Positive ventilation rate increased and crown-tapping check added before entry.

At Kathalguri GCS around 16:30 hrs, compressor K-405 discharge valve and lube oil pump jobs ran parallel. Group lockout box was in use at the other unit. Lube gang finished and removed the common electrical lock for their trial while valve gang had the cover off. Trial made the compressor turn over once as coupling was engaged. Valve cover fell on the floor from the bench. Nobody touching at that moment luckily. Parallel job trials now need both gang leaders at the panel.

Thermic lancing on seized flange near christmas tree of Well NHK-271 on 04.12.2024, 08:35 hrs. Slag collected below on steel plate. After job, plate looked cold from top but bottom side still hot. Helper lifted with glove but hot bottom burnt through glove slowly. He dropped it, no skin contact luckily. Water quenching of slag plate made standard. Well service engineer informed.

Oil stained gunny bags used as temporary mats near Naharkatiya pump house were replaced with proper rubber mats. Gunny bags sent for disposal. Pump house floor now stays dry and clean. The slip point near the suction valve removed fully by the new matting arrangement.
A Merit Logistics employee was pushing an egg crate out of a trailer. While working to get it over the lip of the dock, she lost her footing. Crates fell on her, breaking her tibia.

Employees were drilling a hole through a brick-and-mortar fa ade so that conduit could be run into the building. A hammer drill began to wobble as it was used to bore the hole. An employee went to steady the drill and the drill bit caught and twisted their glove, causing an [OUTCOME] to their right middle finger.

Oily water separator pit at Dumduma. Communication rope was there but entrant clipped it to his tool belt instead of harness D-ring, easier to reach he said. During a slip his tool belt tore off and went into sludge, rope with it. He caught the pit ladder himself. Clips go to D-ring only, no convenience attachments.
activity: OWS pit rope tool belt clip

text: Night of 11.10.2024, around 23:20 hrs. A driver as luck had it, that had disabled the speed lock by sheer chance, to hurry a material delivery missed a parked, unlit tractor on the Moran field road till the last instant. Braking from far also fast, he clipped it. The owner came out of a adjacent house. Majority of as luck had it, mornings at that point, that farm by sheer chance, farm farm tractor on the spot, carries protruding iron just at that point, at that time, rods for the just at that time, market — at speed, at that hr, at that hour, rods like that come through a on the spot, on the spot, windshield. The tampering was admitted. The governor was refitted and the driver got a warning; unlit parking was separately complained about.
activity: light vehicle on lease road at night

text: An employee was operating a cart in the maintenance area when his foot became caught between the cart and a shelf, resulting in a [OUTCOME] foot.

Around 06:50 hrs on 09.04.2025, mobile crane crossing the market stretch near Tinsukia Chariali had its hook block swinging free because it was not tied to the bumper hook. Hook hit one shop awning pole and bent it, then hit one parked scooter and broke its mirror. Shopkeeper came out shouting. Rigger had left the hook loose after morning greasing and forgot. Crane escorted out of market and hook tie-down checking added to pre-transit list. DGMS guideline copy pasted in crane cabin.

During flare line clamp welding at Baghjan EPS on 22.07.2024, monsoon rain had made the whole area waterlogged. Welding machine was kept on wooden plank but cable joint was lying in water. Helper almost touched the joint while shifting the electrode holder. Luckily he pulled back hand. Job stopped, cable re-routed on stand, permit condition rechecked. Matter reported to shift in-charge.
An employee was using a step ladder to get product from the backroom when they fell backward off the ladder to the floor. The employee was [OUTCOME] with a [OUTCOME] pelvis.

Shift log GGS Tengakhat dated 06.09.2024: heavy monsoon night. Flare KO drum boot level rising due to rain ingress through stack seal. Boot drained to slop twice in shift. Stack seal inspection added to next shutdown scope.

Induction of 10 new mazdoor at CTF Duliajan on 23.01.2025 by safety officer with thekedar present. Site hazards explained in simple Hindi: moving crane, hot pipe, deep pit. PPE issued and fitting checked. Muster point walk done. Each worker signed the induction register.

An employee was standing on the side bar of a truck when it drove forward and turned into the car wash entrance. The employee fell off the truck, struck his head on the pavement, and sustained a skull [OUTCOME].

During glycol reboiler burner tip replacement at Baghjan EPS on 06.03.2025, new tip was being threaded when gas smell came strongly. Pilot gas line was still connected and passing. Tip connection was open to atmosphere. All moved out, line isolated. Pilot gas was forgotten because it comes from different manifold than main gas. Energy source list now shows both.

Thermic lancing of stuck flange on gas lift line near wellhead of Well M-209 Moran, 15.10.2024, 09:50 hrs. After lancing, flange gasket area showed small vapour leak when line pressurized for testing. Test stopped, line depressurized, gasket replaced. If leak had come during lancing, flame would have found gas. Test pressure decision after hot work was correct sequence. Production engineer informed.

An employee was changing the location of bolts that held a metal plate on the top of a car wash conveyor. His thumb became stuck between a part of the equipment and a roller on the conveyor. He sustained a [OUTCOME] to the right thumb just above the base knuckle, resulting in an [OUTCOME].
contractor: Club Car Wash Operating, LLC dba Club Car Wash - Edwardsville

text: During reception duty review on 26.11.2025, receptionist at township office found standing entire morning shift on hard floor; no anti-fatigue mat or sitting arrangement during visitor gaps. Mat provided and high stool kept behind counter. Duty hours rearranged to include sitting period between visitor timings.

A python was sighted near the scrap yard of flowline ROW KM 13 culvert. kept safe distance and informed QRT at 02:50 hrs. patrol log updated at 02:50 hrs the same night. Discussed in next toolbox talk.

Instrument cable laying at GGS-2 pipe rack, fitter walking on the top flange of the rack beam carrying cable coil on shoulder. Rack top fully open, 7 m to ground. He has done this for years he said. Years of luck is not a control measure. Brought down, work rescheduled with mobile elevated platform. Repeated violation, contractor called.

Glycol vessel at Kathalguri GCS. Retrieval system tripod head pin was held by a hairpin clip instead of proper locking pin, done in hurry. During practice hoist, clip sprang off and head pin worked half out, tripod wobbled. Dummy load swayed. Correct pin brought from store, fit, checked. Hairpin clip is for hair, rigger said, not for retrieval. Everyone remembered the line.

At around 10:35 hrs at rig #7, mud pump suction manifold was lifted by crane with slings on pipe body, manifold had loose blanking plate inside. Plate slid during lifting and fell out from open end, hit the ground near mud tank. Plate weighed 8 kg, fell from 12 feet. Nobody below fortunately, area was barricaded for lift. Open ends checked for loose internals before lifting, blanking plates removed or secured. Manifold installed without further issue that day.

While replacing mechanical seal of lean oil pump at Kathalguri GCS around 11:30 hrs, only tag was tied on the supply valve because padlock was broken. Store issued new lock but helper forgot to bring it. Operator on routine check opened the supply valve seeing pump idle. Oil flooded the open casing and fitter's hand was inside. He pulled out soaked hand, no cut from the impeller by chance. Lock fixed immediately, broken-lock reporting made same-day must.

During mud pump discharge dampener connection tightening at rig #7, trapped pressure pocket behind one plug released suddenly and plug flew across pump room, narrowly missed skull of passing mud engineer and hit the wall. Plug had no vent hole. Vent type plugs procured for dampener.
barrier: pressure gauge reads zero but trapped pocket

text: On 19.12.2025, around 19:45 hrs, at Kathalguri GCS, the standby man posted for DG-2 exhaust duct entry by M/s Jorhat Engineering was found wearing both ear-muffs against the pump noise, out of hearing of the worker inside. The entrant had to come to the manway himself to attract attention. Entry stopped and the standby changed. Standby-duty card printed in Assamese and Hindi and clipped to every permit.
An employee was painting a gazebo when he fell 10 feet from the top of the gazebo. The employee sustained a [OUTCOME] arm. Fall protection was not in place at the time.

Mock rescue exercise at Kathaloni CPF on 01.10.2024. Scenario dummy person inside dyke area, retrieved using ladder and rope. QRT response 2 min 40 sec. Safety harness of one rescuer found with faded tag, replaced from store. Exercise only, photos for safety month display.

An employee had been cribbing/chocking wood between layers of pipe on a rack. When the last layer of material was loaded on the rack, the employee noticed the last joint was crooked and began to manually adjust the pipe (5 1/2 inches wide, 46 feet long) into place. The pipe slid off, causing the material to strike the employee's lower right leg. The leg was broken in the shin area.

Today around 18:20 hrs, our crew van was behind a bullock cart on a narrow road near GGS-2. cart stopped and the two animals started fighting each other, cart shaking side to side. van reversed back to wider portion. one scooter behind van also reversed. animals settled after 5 minutes. nobody tried to go near. animal behaviour nobody can predict, distance only answer.
activity: crew van movement on village road

text: Glycol vessel at Kathalguri GCS, attendant also issuing tools from the job tool box, turning his back to manway each issue. Entrant signalled for retrieval as his glove was trapped under a slipped tray edge he was refitting; no response, he worked the glove off finger by finger, left it, came up one-gloved. Glove retrieved next entry. Tools issued before entry, or by a second man. The glove stayed behind like a resignation letter.

While unloading drill pipe at Well JJM-12 around 11:40 hrs today, pipe bundle strap cut under tension when side post removed early. three pipes rolled off toward walkway side. pump man washing hands at tap heard the roll and ran behind tank. pipes stopped against walkway kerb. post removal sequence now painted on trailer with arrows.

Power house UG sump at Naharkatiya: monsoon night, backflow from yard drain filled sump while pump on maintenance, mechanic inside coupling the shaft. water to thigh in ten minutes. he climbed out leaving tools, just in time. tools recovered next day. man recovering tools is much harder. NRV on drain line.

Foggy morning 19.12.2024, about 06:50 hrs. Dispatched to Moran field without a journey plan. Near the level crossing the driver missed the fog diversion and tailgated a truck that was equally lost; both ended up at the closed crossing gate in thick fog. Turning around in that pocket, our rear slid into the crossing-side drain; the truck pulled us out with a chain. A train at that moment does not bear thinking about. Fog diversion maps now live in every vehicle door pocket.

Jorajan, receiver support saddle repair. The receiver was drained of air but still held a sloshing load of oily condensate, and when the fitter cut the corroded saddle bracket free, the vessel shifted a few millimetres on its remaining support, the weight of liquid making it unpredictable. The bracket snapped away and the receiver settled with a groan. His hands were off the saddle by then. Condensate drained fully and vessel chocked before support work now.

One afternoon at Naharkatiya on 09.09.2025, staircase railing straightening with chain block tied to roof nozzle. Fitter applying force on railing while standing with back to open edge. Chain block hook slipped from nozzle and railing sprang back. He fell backwards towards edge, stopped by luck against stair post. Chain block anchoring to process nozzle itself was wrong. Proper anchor pad eye fitted on roof for such pulling jobs afterwards.

04.11.2025, around 06:40 hrs: breathing air line of contract fitter of M/s Sadiya Services inside DG-1 exhaust duct at Kathalguri GCS kinked sharply at the damper plate and flow dropped to almost nothing. He felt the flow stop early and reversed out himself. Standby man raised the alarm only after he came out. Line rerouted overhead the same shift and pre-entry line-stretch check added to the permit attachment.

19.12.2025 at Kathalguri GCS, around 15:10 hrs: during DG-4 exhaust duct soot cleaning by M/s Jorhat Engineering, agreed rope-tug signals from inside were missed twice because of the nearby air compressor at full load. The worker inside kept working unaware. Miss discovered when attendant pulled the rope and felt no return tug. Entry halted, worker brought out safely, and a battery klaxon line now rigged for all duct entries.

CP rectifier at Duliajan GGS-2 on 28.02.2025. Anode bed resistance measurement near flare pit side. Long test lead stretched across gravel road and one pickup truck drove over the lead, pulling the instrument off the stand. Technician caught instrument but lead plug came near his face. Road crossing boards now placed, second person posted as road watch during measurement.

Instrument air header pressure at GGS-1 Duliajan dropped to 6.1 kg/cm2 during start of second air compressor loading cycle. Pressure switch chatter seen on recorder. Unloader adjusted by compressor technician. Header steady at 7.0 now.

Ladder work at GGS-4 for instrument air regulator above the compressor canopy. Ladder top resting on thin canopy sheet edge. Sheet bent under load while fitter was mid ladder. He came down immediately. Ladder repositioned to the structural frame with extension. Canopy sheet is not structure, same lesson as gutter and vent neck. List of non-anchors circulated.

When doing hot tap tie-in welding on produced water line at GGS-4 on 20.09.2025, found in pre-job checking that the welding machine was kept inside the dike area of adjacent tank for shade. Machine fuel cap was loose, fuel smell was there. Machine shifted outside dike and fuel tightened. Fuel inside dike near hot work is double risk, told gang. Machine placement now outside dike always. Fuel cap check added in machine daily inspection.

On 15.12.2025 at Kathalguri GCS, around 06:40 hrs, entry into DG-3 exhaust duct by M/s Brahmaputra Enterprise began although the calibrated meter was sent for repair and not replaced. Ten minutes in, the rescue-tripod rigger questioned it and the entry was aborted. Follow-up test showed oxygen at the duct floor below normal near the far end. No-test-no-entry strictly enforced and a second meter kept charged at the GCS panel.
An employee fell from a 3-foot step stool to the ground, resulting in a [OUTCOME] left hip.

The no-smoking board at the CTF Duliajan tank dyke entrance had peeled paint and the red circle was barely visible. Found during the monthly HSE round. A new aluminium board was fixed at the same post. No smoking violation had occurred there. All dyke entrance boards in the area checked together.

04.11.2025, around 11:25 hrs: inside DG-3 exhaust duct at Kathalguri GCS, a slab of baked soot fell from the duct crown and the M/s Sadiya Services worker was enveloped in a black cloud with visibility reduced to nothing. He stayed low, followed the air line back and came out coughing, eyes watering. Shower used and first aider checked him. Positive ventilation rate increased and crown-tapping check added before entry.

An employee was helping remove a dead animal from a barn. A truck was backing up to the barn to retrieve the body, and its lift platform pinned the employee's leg against the barn. The leg was [OUTCOME] lacerated and the employee was [OUTCOME], requiring [OUTCOME].

Christmas tree lifting at Well NHK-81 during workover. Afternoon, wind calm but thunder heard far away. Crew discussed, decided to continue as sky clear overhead. Twenty minutes later, gust front arrived suddenly, tree swinging at height. Emergency lower done. Weather can change fast in this season. Distant thunder now treated as wind warning, lift paused and monitored.

Yesterday evening around 18:20 hrs forklift with raised forks was travelling across GGS-2 loading area. forks almost touched head of driver of parked pickup who came out suddenly from cabin. fortunately he bent down just in time. travelling with raised forks is regular habit here. warned forklift agency M/s Radha Transport second time.
activity: forklift yard travel with raised forks

text: N2 purged vessel at Dumduma, tripod winch rope was tied off to nearby staircase handrail as extra security. Handrail was aluminium, decorative type. During rescue drill with dummy, handrail bent like banana at first real pull. Dummy hung halfway. Everyone went quiet. Steel structure column used after. Drill exposed it; better the dummy than our fitter, the safety officer said.

Lighting transformer replacement at Digboi on 03.08.2024. During backfilling of pole pit, earthing conductor of transformer found cut and ends left near LT bushing. When transformer energized for testing, helper standing in waterlogged pit holding the earth wire end felt strong tingling. Supply switched off immediately. Earth continuity made proper with crimped joint, pits kept dewatered before testing.

During calibration of demulsifier pump at Kathalguri GCS, fitter's thumb came between coupling and guard slot while checking alignment with pump in inch mode. Inching was done by helper on shout from fitter but a third person also pressed the button. Thumb grazed, first aid given. Could have been much worse. Inching not covered in permit isolation steps.

On March 20, 2024, at approximately 6:15 AM, the [OUTCOME] employee was assisting four other employees in drilling holes for guardrail installation with a pneumatic drill attached to a trailer-mounted air compressor. While moving the air hose, it was pulled taught by the moving trailer and it tripped the [OUTCOME] employee, causing them to strike their head on the pavement and sustain a blood clot to their temple area.

Toolbox talk at GGS Balimara on 16.02.2024 about handling of paint and thinner. Ventilation, no smoking, gloves and mask, lid closed after use. 7 workers attended. One thinner tin found open in store, closed immediately. Store ventilation fan running checked.

Observation at Naharkatiya: crane for spool erection near pumping unit area had an outrigger on the old flowline trench backfill of a rod-pumping well. Soil was loose there. Crane repositioned after check. Trench lines around pumping wells now marked by operations before crane entry.
activity: spool lifting at height over live equipment

text: Yesterday night around 01:30 hrs at Duliajan GGS-2, fire watch dozed off on chair during flowline support welding near live gas line. Welding slag fell on his own raincoat kept nearby and it started burning. He woke up smelling it and threw it off. Luckily spark did not travel to line side. Both welder and watch warned. Night rotation of fire watch made every 2 hours from now.

415V panel at Kathalguri on 08.08.2024. During panel extension busbar coupling, fish plate bolt torque was being checked with long torque wrench. Wrench length crossed into the live side chamber through the coupling opening — rubber boot was not yet fitted. Wrench touched live busbar and flash came. Wrench had insulation sleeve half length only. Coupling opening now sealed with the boot before any torque work from the dead side.

Crane at Baghjan EPS was lifting old flare line section near flare pit. Section had sludge inside, sludge came out from open end when tilted, fell on ground below with splash. One worker was near the splash zone edge, sludge drops fell on his coverall, not on skin. Open end facing up during lifting, sludge removed before lifting where possible. Coverall changed, worker washed. Sludge sample sent for checking as per waste procedure. Lift completed after plugging open end.

DG exhaust duct inspection was on at Kathalguri GCS on 14.03.2025. Breathing air hose from trolley passed under door mat, mat edge and hose pressed by trolley wheel when attendant shifted trolley closer. Kink formed. Worker inside felt air drop, came out. Trolley position marked with paint line afterward. Comfort shifting of trolley must not touch the life line.

The [OUTCOME] employee was on the ground level while other employees were tarping a hole at the facility. A cinder block (5-8 pounds) fell approximately 10 feet from a building due to the high winds and damage from a hurricane. The employee was looking upward at the roof and the concrete block struck the employee's hard hat, knocking it off and hitting him in the face and left hand. The employee fell backward and struck the back of his head on the concrete floor. The employee sustained contusions to his lip, jaw, and left hand and a traumatic brain [OUTCOME], and he required staples to the back of their head.

UA/UC observation: communication rope missing from confined space kit at Naharkatiya GGS-3 valve chamber work site. Workers using ordinary nylon rope which can slip from hand. Condition reported in UA/UC register. Proper rope with snap hook issued same evening and toolbox talk given on kit contents.

DG exhaust duct at Kathalguri GCS inspected on 11.12.2024 for cracked baffle. Breathing air hose passed through narrow duct opening and the edge cut into outer layer, kinking inner tube. Pressure gauge at manifold dropped. Worker felt suffocation, pulled himself out by rope just in time. Duct mouth edge padded afterward. Near miss discussed in monthly HSE meet.
On September 23, 2024, an employee was pulling a pallet of water off a trailer in the dock area when he was struck by a pallet jack that crushed his right little toe. The employee was [OUTCOME].

At around 14:30 hrs on 17-04-2025, one mobile charger left plugged in empty shift room at GGS Kathalguri was found swollen and warm with plastic smell. Unplugged and kept in metal tray to cool. Charger was local make, disposed in e-waste bin. Rule made that personal chargers must be unplugged when room empty. Photo shared in WhatsApp safety group as awareness.

07.11.2025, around 15:10 hrs: inside DG-4 exhaust duct at Kathalguri GCS, the scraper bit into a hard soot ridge and it collapsed and the M/s Purbanchal Services worker was enveloped in a black cloud with visibility reduced to nothing. He stayed low, followed the air line back and came out coughing, eyes watering. Shower used and first aider checked him. Positive ventilation rate increased and crown-tapping check added before entry.

07.11.2025, around 11:25 hrs: breathing air line of contract fitter of M/s Purbanchal Services inside DG-2 exhaust duct at Kathalguri GCS got trapped under the soot shovel left at the bend and flow dropped to almost nothing. He banged twice on the duct wall and came out on his own. Standby man raised the alarm only after he came out. Line rerouted overhead the same shift and pre-entry line-stretch check added to the permit attachment.
An employee was using a hydraulic shear machine to cut a copper pipe and partially [OUTCOME] their right ring finger.

Evacuation drill at Digboi office complex on 26.01.2025. Republic day week drill. 130 persons from three buildings cleared in 6 min 30 sec. Fire warden in each floor checked toilets before leaving. Exercise only. One warden on leave, substitute not aware, list updated immediately.

MCC room maintenance at Duliajan GGS-2 on 03.04.2025 night shift. Control fuse of mud pump area feeder to be replaced. Electrician opened fuse carrier with hand directly without testing, believing control transformer OFF from panel. Control supply was coming from UPS bypass line. Small flash came from fuse carrier, he dropped it. Narrowly missed finger contact. Control source diagram corrected and displayed inside MCC room itself.

During injection rate check at Kathalguri GCS, pump PSV lifted and methanol discharged through vent line which terminates near the walkway to GGS control room. Strong smell, one visitor complained of headache, rested and fine. PSV vent routing flagged for modification and area barricaded meanwhile.

Complaint received from finance section staff on 07.10.2024 that staircase handrail between ground and first floor is shaking when held. Checked personally and found two anchor bolts rusted and loose. Maintenance mistri tightened same day but replacement of rusted bolts recommended; job card raised for weekend work.
An employee was cleaning a conveyor belt when the towel he was using was caught in the conveyor; his hand was pulled into the conveyor belt and crushed.

An employee was working to close a gate that had gotten stuck. He was pushing on the top rail when it started moving and his left little finger became crushed between the rollers and the top rail, resulting in an [OUTCOME] below the bottom knuckle.

An employee was preparing to dump wood from a roll-off dumpster when a piece of timber fell from the dumpster and struck the employee in the head. The employee sustained a laceration to the scalp and three cracked vertebral discs.

At around 10:40 hrs on 18.10.2025, gate pass counter clerk at Duliajan Field HQ found stamping passes in standing bent posture over low counter; hundreds of stamps daily during shift change rush. Counter height raised with wooden top and stool provided. Stamping practice reviewed and half the passes shifted to printed stickers.

During DG-3 exhaust duct inspection at Kathalguri GCS on 02.12.2025, around 15:10 hrs, worker inside the hot duct found his tapping signals unanswered. The posted attendant of M/s Purbanchal Services was called away for a phone call at the GCS office. Worker exited on his own after several anxious minutes. Entry was suspended, attendance-at-post rule re-explained to both shifts, and a no-relief-no-entry line added to the confined-space register.

An employee had just used a cart to move a computer desk to a dumpster and was moving the desk off the cart to the ground. A drawer slid out of the desk onto the ground. The employee jumped onto the drawer to demolish it; when his feet contacted the drawer, it slid away, causing him to lose balance and fall to the ground. He suffered two broken bones in the lower right leg.
An employee was descending a 10-foot platform ladder when he mis-stepped on the fourth rung. His landed on his right heel, breaking it.

On 04.11.2025, around 15:10 hrs, contract mazdoor of M/s Sadiya Services entered DG-3 exhaust duct at Kathalguri GCS only forty minutes after shutdown. Inside he felt the grating hot through his boots and came out within minutes with reddened hands from touching the wall for balance. Job stopped and rescheduled. Supervisor reminded that shutdown time is not cooling time; temperature strip now pasted at the manway.

Foggy morning at Digboi, visibility poor. one electrician helper entered transformer pit to check cable while main attendant went to bring tea and was talking on phone outside gate. helper finished and came out alone. nobody knew he was inside. permit system bypassed fully. strict warning issued to contractor.

An employee was replacing/repairing a plane wheel. They were putting the wheel back onto the plane when the wheel slipped and pinched their left thumb against a brake rotor. The employee's thumb tip was [OUTCOME].

An employee was drilling holes with a hammer drill, vacuum bit, and vacuum. He was starting a new hole and grabbed the bit with his left hand between the vacuum attachment and the drill chuck. The drill continued to spin, catching his glove/little finger and wrapping it up, resulting in the [OUTCOME] of the finger.

On June 17, 2025, at approximately 3:30 p.m., two employees were servicing a refrigeration unit on a roof. The [OUTCOME] employee was inspecting the orientation of a sprocket in a different unit when air pressure generated by the unit caused the door to shut on their right thumb, resulting in an [OUTCOME] at the first knuckle.
contractor: The Hillshire Brands Company a Wholly Owned Subsidiary of Tyson Foods, Inc.

text: Around 03:10 hrs on 07.11.2024, water bowser skidded at ramp turn near Moran GCS and hit the fire water hydrant post. Hydrant cap flew and water started gushing. Driver reversed and valve closed by fireman after ten minutes, ramp became more slippery with the water. One more vehicle waiting behind had to go back long route. Hydrant too close to vehicle turning path, protection barrier demanded. Fire water loss also affected readiness for some time, QRT kept standby.

Two forklift drivers were stopped next to each other and were talking. The [OUTCOME] employee leaned out of their forklift as the other forklift was leaving and they became pinned between the two forklifts. The [OUTCOME] employee was [OUTCOME] with a [OUTCOME] rib and a lacerated lung.

At around 03:20 hrs at Kathalguri GCS, methanol pump auto-started when its LOTO lock was hanging but DCS soft bypass of the start inhibit was left active from previous day testing. Coupling cover was open at that time. Nobody was touching, fortunately. Soft bypass not visible in field, energy source list now includes DCS inhibits.

Around 03:05 hrs during B to C shift change at Kathalguri GCS, outgoing crew had stopped the lean oil circulation pump for strainer cleaning and told the incoming operator verbally to not start it. No lock, no tag, no permit entry, only verbal. Incoming operator noted the pump as stopped in the log but the relieving supervisor, not aware, gave start instruction on wireless for the process requirement while contract fitter Hemanta had the strainer cover fully open and both hands inside. Pump primed and oil gushed from the open cover onto his arms and chest. He came out from under the pump soaked, slipping on the grating but holding the handrail. Only oil bath, nothing more. Verbal isolation system fully stopped from that night, LOTO or nothing.

While doing drum loading at methanol shed around 13:15 hrs on 11.10.2024, forklift hydraulic hose burst with spray when drum lifted. operator lowered load and got down with oil spray on sleeve. helper standing two feet away got spray on his face, eyes closed in time. oil washed at safety shower nearby. hose had rubbing mark from long time. hose routing checked on all forklifts after this.
activity: forklift drum loading at methanol shed

text: An employee was working from a basket on a telehandler, changing light fixture heads on light poles. The employee moved the telehandler perpendicular to a slope. As the telehandler basket was going up, and was about 7-8 feet to the light, the telehandler tipped over. The employee was [OUTCOME] with a broken right leg, arm, and lacerations to the chest.

During well testing at well pad NHK-208 on 25.05.2025, portable generator cable got pulled by vehicle and supply to data logger lost. Small UPS of logger took over and full test data saved. Cable route changed and ramp provided. Could have lost complete well test data. Test team told about cable protection. Logged.

On August 6, 2025, an employee was preparing to weld a metal sheet that goes between containers and weighs 800 pounds. The employee was placing a two-foot wooden brace (4 by 4) under the metal, which was being raised by a crane operator using a magnet. The magnet shifted and caused the load to catch the employee's right index fingertip against the wooden brace, resulting in a fingertip [OUTCOME].

Slew brake band relining on the old yard crane at Moran GGS-1. The band tension spring was being held 'by hand pressure' while the anchor pin was driven out - the thekedar's man said he had done it many times. Spring won; the band snapped straight and the pin punch flew off, grazing the drum and landing in the oil tray. His grip held the punch, that is the only reason it did not fly at the group. Spring clamps now made in workshop for this job.

At around 11:40 hrs, Baghjan EPS drum yard, the forklift's hydraulic control valve was being resealed. The mechanic isolated the battery and hung a tag, but did not try the levers. Residual pressure in the tilt circuit pushed the spool out of its bore when the retaining plate came off, and oil followed, soaking his sleeve. The spool hit the floor where his foot had been. Levers cycled and gauge read zero - now the written first step.
barrier: isolation done but not verified by try-start

text: 12.11.2025, around 19:45 hrs: inside DG-1 exhaust duct at Kathalguri GCS, the standby blower door was opened the wrong way and the M/s Kalita & Sons worker was enveloped in a black cloud with visibility reduced to nothing. He stayed low, followed the air line back and came out coughing, eyes watering. Shower used and first aider checked him. Positive ventilation rate increased and crown-tapping check added before entry.

At about 03:50 hrs on 18.07.2025, crew Bolero going to Kathalguri found the corridor road blocked by one elephant and one forest department vehicle also waiting. Both waited together. Forest person told that one calf is stuck in the mud near the beel and herd is standing there for that. After two hours forest team rescued the calf and herd moved. Our crew reached site very late but with good story. Wildlife rescue coordination between forest department and field vehicles works well in this area.
activity: field crew transport via elephant corridor

text: An employee was on stilts, hanging insulation in a unit. At the same time, drywall stockers were staging drywall on 2x4 beams, which protruded out from under the drywall stack. The employee tripped over one of the beams and fell to the ground, resulting in a broken left arm.

One page of the GCS Tengakhat security register was found torn at the corner where an old entry was half cut. The missing portion could be read from the carbon copy beneath. Entry re-written on the margin with a note and both pages initialled. Register pages now numbered and binding strengthened.

At around 03:15 hrs on 9 February 2025 during POOH on rig #5, one tubing joint rolled off the pipe rack beam end as stop pin was missing, rolled across floor towards crew busy at tongs. Driller shouted and all moved just in time. Joint hit the sub-structure with loud bang. Stop pins checked for full rack before operations continued.

18.11.2025, around 23:30 hrs: inside DG-2 exhaust duct at Kathalguri GCS, a shovel struck the duct wall and dislodged loose scale and the M/s Brahmaputra Enterprise worker was enveloped in a black cloud with visibility reduced to nothing. He stayed low, followed the air line back and came out coughing, eyes watering. Shower used and first aider checked him. Positive ventilation rate increased and crown-tapping check added before entry.

While doing valve greasing route at GGS-2 Duliajan manifold area, one 2 inch ball valve found very hard to operate. Excess old grease flushed out and fresh grease injected. Valve now operating free. No other abnormality on route.

At Kathalguri GCS around 21:25 hrs, panel key of the standby compressor was left in after the weekly auto test. Operator wanted to check the lube pressure and bumped the start button while mechanic's hand was on the discharge valve nut. Crank moved slightly, nut spanner slipped and cut the paint. Hand withdrawn at once. Weekly test now ends with key out and lock on.

Produced-sand pit at Naharkatiya: pit edge timber curb rotted, gave way under mazdoor foot at edge. he windmilled, buddy grabbed his belt, pulled him back from 3.5 metre drop onto sand heap below. curb looked painted and fine from top. timber replaced with steel angle, edge checks weekly.

On May 23, 2025, an employee was training to drive an end-rider forklift when they lost balance and stepped off the forklift. Their left ankle was caught between the forklift and a pallet of water. The employee was [OUTCOME] with [OUTCOME] to their ankle and required [OUTCOME].

Scraper trap at Kathalguri GCS, attendant was also adjusting the closure door gasket with fitter while technician was inside barrel. Door weight shifted unexpectedly and barrel mouth narrowed few inches. Technician pushed door back from inside with his shoulder and shouted. Few inches more and his exit route was a wrestling match. Door secured with locking pin during any man-inside work, attendant back to watching the man, not the gasket.

Two employees were using a forklift to reset a 1,500-pound tote of mineral powder back onto a skid. The second employee was operating the forklift while the [OUTCOME] employee was working to set a strap around the tote. The [OUTCOME] employee's little finger got pinched between the forks and a metal container, resulting in an [OUTCOME] at the second knuckle.
contractor: Honda Development & Manufacturing of America, LLC

text: Excavation pit at Naharkatiya GGS-3 for the flowline anchor block. Worker descended with harness but the lifeline had a knot at middle joining two rope pieces, knot could not pass through tripod pulley, retrieval would jam halfway. Knot found during drill pull. Continuous single-piece rope for lifelines only, joined ropes downgraded to lashing.
activity: pit anchor block joined rope issue

text: During monthly tool checking at EPS Tengakhat on 12.04.2025, found one portable electric drill with the chuck key spring broken and key loosely hanging. Drill tagged and sent to workshop. Key fitted properly and drill tested. All portable tools of the contractor gang checked same day. Three tools tagged out for repair.

Welding on substructure at Rig OIL-44, Balimara on 05.08.2024. Night job, rain stopped one hour back. Welding cable connector box was on ground which was still wet. Connector got warm and small smoke came from box. Box lifted on stand and covered. Connector box on wet ground will fail one day. Rig electrician informed, all boxes checked.

An employee was working on a swing scaffold, preparing to install terracotta tile on the exterior of a building. Terracotta tiles that had been previously installed on the building detached and fell striking the employee in the head. The employee suffered lacerations to the head, a head [OUTCOME], bleeding around the brain, and neck and back [OUTCOME].

During joint HSE audit with OISD checklist at Moran GGS-1 on 19.08.2024, auditor asked climber at tower to demonstrate emergency descent. Climber unhooked both lanyards and climbed down few rungs to show speed. Auditor stopped him immediately. Demonstration also needs 100 percent tie off. Climber was experienced 15 years man, habit of free climbing. Audit point closed with refresher and twin lanyard strict compliance photo evidence for one month.

The emergency exit marking above the admin block Duliajan side door had faded and the sticker was peeling at the corners. Noted during the office safety walk. New glow-type sticker pasted the same day and the door checked to open freely. No drill or real use had happened with the faded marking. Recorded and closed.

Crude tank at Naharkatiya GGS-3. Communication rope was fine but entrant and standby developed their own signal code, not the standard one. Third worker relieving standby used standard code, entrant understood opposite, came up when told stay. Confusion but no harm. Standard code only, personal codes banned, chart at every entry point.

Forklift with drum grab attachment at Duliajan GGS-2 grabbed drum by top rim only. Drum slipped from grab at 5 feet, fell on side and rolled towards methanol unloading area. Worker there saw it coming and stepped behind column. Drum stopped at column base, cap held. Grab jaw pressure adjusted, damaged rim drums rejected for grab lifting, drum trolley used for such drums. Incident shared in HSE bulletin.
Gutter cleaning at GGS-4 pump house roof edge, no harness, gentle slope he said. Gentle slope still ends at concrete five meters down. Lifeline fixed first, then work allowed.
barrier: no harness for roof edge work

text: On May 14, 2024, an employee was raising the dump body on a dump truck to unload mulch. When it would not raise, the employee checked underneath the dump body to look for the issue and the dump body dropped down onto his arm, pinning it against the frame. The truck then rolled down a slight incline, dragging the employee with it. The employee's right forearm was [OUTCOME] and arteries and blood vessels were [OUTCOME].
An employee was walking by an air compressor when the fitting securing the hose broke off and struck the employee's left leg below the knee. The employee sustained a [OUTCOME] left leg.

Welder's helper doing the tack job without a leather apron, just his normal coverall. Work paused, apron issued from the job PPE kit, and the helper briefed on why cotton alone is not enough near spatter.

Crane at Kathalguri GCS was lifting new chemical dosing skid when rigger noticed sling tag missing, certificate not traceable. Load already at two feet. Lift stopped, load landed, sling verified from store record, found OK but tag lost. Tag re-fixed with wire, lift done. Tag missing sling should be treated as failed, this rule told to all. Sling register updated, tag fixing method improved with plastic covered tags. Rigger appreciated for stopping job despite schedule pressure.

An employee was grabbing a line for a load (3,000 lbs.) that was being lifted by a crane when their right hand was caught between the load and a slab on the floor. The employee sustained a laceration, a torn tendon, and a [OUTCOME] right wrist.
An employee was cutting meat using a meat saw when their finger was caught by the blade, resulting in an [OUTCOME].
An employee was troubleshooting a machine when he slipped and went to brace himself. His hand entered the machine and the blade contacted his finger, resulting in a fingertip [OUTCOME].

During DG-2 exhaust duct inspection at Kathalguri GCS on 07.11.2025, around 23:30 hrs, the breathing air line routed across the walkway was run over by a gas-cylinder trolley, pinching it flat for some minutes. The M/s Purbanchal Services worker inside felt the supply weaken, knocked on the duct and came out safely. Walkway crossing eliminated by rerouting the line overhead and a hose-ramp kept at the crossing point.
An employee was moving a large package from a slide when her left arm got caught between the slide (tilt tray) and the package. She was [OUTCOME] with a [OUTCOME] left arm.

Welding on substructure at Rig OIL-49, Hapjan on 08.09.2024. Welder used drum as stool for sitting weld. Drum was old grease drum, inside had residue. Heat conducted and drum lid popped with small flame from residue vapour. He jumped off. Drum removed and proper stool made. Never sit on closed drum for welding. Tool pusher informed.
An employee was cleaning a grain bin when his left foot was caught by the pull-off auger, resulting in the [OUTCOME] of the foot.

During night inspection of DG-3 exhaust duct at Kathalguri GCS on 12.11.2025, around 11:25 hrs, the intrinsically safe hand lamp of the M/s Kalita & Sons helper flickered out deep inside the duct and the only torch with the attendant had a cracked lens. He waited against the wall and guided himself out along the air line. Lamp-plus-spare check made a signed permit line item; two more EX-rated lamps procured for the GCS.

Inspection of DG exhaust duct was done at Kathalguri GCS on 22.02.2025. Air line from breathing set passed over duct flange and when worker moved deep, flange edge pressed hose flat. His whistle fell inside duct and he could not signal. Attendant keeping time check pulled him out after no response on rope signal. Just in time. Edge protection added same day.

Sump pit near fire water jockey pump at Kathalguri GCS entered on 29.04.2025. Blower was on, but night guard had moved its duct to dry his rain coat over warm motor casing, duct end pulled out of pit. Pit man inside felt air gone, came up, saw coat arrangement. Coat dried, lesson given. Duct position is not adjustable for laundry.

Crane at Kathalguri GCS lifting old air receiver when receiver lifting lug was on top but receiver was horizontal, sling pulled lug sideways. Lug bent, receiver rolled on ground from sling. Receiver was empty fortunately. Lug orientation versus lift direction explained, rolling load control by tag line. Receiver lifted with body sling afterwards. Bent lug ground off, not reused. Horizontal vessel lifting method statement prepared by engineer for all such vessels in plant for future jobs.

An employee was cutting the banding off the end of a bundle of PVC pipe when a piece of the pipe fell, bounced, and struck them in the face. They sustained a broken nose and a concussion and were [OUTCOME].

Humid monsoon day 21.07.2025, DG exhaust duct inspection at Kathalguri GCS was done. Worker inside duct sweating heavily, mask seal slipping, he adjusted mask with one hand and pressed hose against duct bend with elbow, kink formed. He felt both leak and choke, exited and took break. Mask fit checked before re-entry. Sweat management inside duct is real issue in July.

During crew change to Kathalguri on 09.01.2025 around 04:00 hrs, driver came across one elephant blocking the road and halted at distance. Animal did not move for long time. Driver used the vehicle horn lightly thinking it will move, elephant turned and came toward the vehicle. Driver reversed fast. Elephant followed for some distance and stopped. Horn use in corridor is prohibited, told again. Driver was given written warning and corridor training refresher done for the full transport team this month.
activity: field crew transport via elephant corridor

text: At GGS-4 CTF around 16:50 hrs, agitator gearbox oil change and platform grating repair were combined. Group lockout box available but both gangs assumed the other had locked. Nobody locked actually. Welding helper wanted to rotate the agitator for access and asked panel to inch. Gearbox man's hand was at the filler plug. Motor inched, plug key flew near his face. He ducked, key hit the handrail. Assumption removed by lock-count check at the box itself.

A length of old GI pipe at the GGS-3 Duliajan scrap corner had rolled out of the corner marking onto the path. The round man rolled it back inside and told the store to stack pipes with end stops. Nobody passed there meanwhile. Scrap corner boundary repainted and pipe stack secured the same week.

During DG-1 exhaust duct inspection at Kathalguri GCS on 15.12.2025, around 23:30 hrs, worker inside the hot duct found his tapping signals unanswered. The posted attendant of M/s Brahmaputra Enterprise was helping a passing trolley driver on the walkway. Worker exited on his own after several anxious minutes. Entry was suspended, attendance-at-post rule re-explained to both shifts, and a no-relief-no-entry line added to the confined-space register.

Trailer driver moved vehicle while crane was still lowering tubular bundle at Duliajan GGS-2 yard. One sling wire snapped, pipes shifted but held by second sling. Banksman had gone for water. Driver suspended from site.

On 23.04.2025, during DG exhaust duct inspection at Kathalguri GCS side, Worker inside duct crawling forward, air hose followed fine, but his spare regulator in pocket swung and pressed hose against duct wall rib, flattening it. Flow dropped, he felt drag in breathing, adjusted and came out. Loose items in pockets removed before duct entry now. Small press, full choke.
Welder at GGS-1 Moran was using a welding glass cracked at one corner since a week, managing like that. Glass replaced from tool store immediately and old one discarded.

One gardener contract staff got ant bite on ankle while trimming hedge near Balimara office. Cold water wash done and soothing cream applied from first aid box. He resumed work after some rest. Grass area checked for ant nests and two nests treated. Gumboot use advised for all gardening work.

During night inspection of DG-4 exhaust duct at Kathalguri GCS on 18.11.2025, around 15:10 hrs, the intrinsically safe hand lamp of the M/s Brahmaputra Enterprise helper flickered out deep inside the duct and the second lamp had been issued to another job. He waited against the wall and guided himself out along the air line. Lamp-plus-spare check made a signed permit line item; two more EX-rated lamps procured for the GCS.

The gauge post stood exactly at the steep drop — it stopped us, nothing else did. Monsoon night, 16.08.2024, about 19:50 hrs: an erosion-monitoring driver at Dangori bund who had been out since morning slept, and the pickup hit the water-level gauge post, knocking it into the river. He woke to the vehicle shaking. The post was reinstalled next day. Monitoring cannot be one man for sixteen hours; a two-shift system for flood monitoring was implemented from that week.
activity: pickup on bund road in monsoon

text: Duty operator at rig site KTK-15 saw that a hailstorm passed over rig site KTK-15 at 15:55 hrs, hail size small. the trench was pumped out, joints inspected and joints re-sealed with m-seal. raincoats counted, 6 torn ones replaced. Entry made in log book.

While racking out one 315 kW SRP motor feeder ACB at Kathalguri MCC room on 12.07.2024, load was still connected as operator had not tripped from field local station. Heavy sparking and loud sound came when trolley moved out. Mistri of M/s Pragati Electricals pulled hand back just in time. Could have been major arc flash incident. Breaker inspected, interlock checked, matter discussed in next morning toolbox talk.

While doing burner management system check at Tengakhat on 25.07.2025, technician forced the pilot solenoid open for testing without informing field. Pilot lit with the front cover open. Fitter near the cover got heat on face, pulled back just in time. Test forcing was not part of energy source list of the reboiler.
On January 23, 2024, an employee sustained finger [OUTCOME] while operating a portable table saw to cut a wooden board.

Welding on substructure at Rig OIL-43, Tengakhat on 16.07.2024. Monsoon night, insects gathered near welding arc light. Welder distracted and arc touched the adjacent hydraulic hose of tong line. Small hole in hose outer layer. Hose changed before tong use. Hydraulic oil spray plus arc could have made jet flame. Hose covered with protective sleeve after that. Tool pusher informed.

On 18.11.2025, around 06:40 hrs, contract mazdoor of M/s Brahmaputra Enterprise entered DG-2 exhaust duct at Kathalguri GCS while the stack was still steaming lightly. Inside he felt the grating hot through his boots and came out within minutes with reddened hands from touching the wall for balance. Job stopped and rescheduled. Supervisor reminded that shutdown time is not cooling time; temperature strip now pasted at the manway.

An employee was walking over to a hoist. He went to step over a pump truck hose when his foot became caught between the hose and its attached strap, and he tripped and fell. The employee sustained a left leg [OUTCOME].

While doing methanol skid valve greasing at Kathalguri GCS on 21.06.2025, crew found injection line check valve bonnet leaking. They tried tightening bonnet bolts with line live. One bolt sheared and leak increased, vapour came. They ran back, QRT cordoned. Live tightening practice stopped. Isolation list of the line was outdated after check valve replacement modification.

During lifting of compressor package at Baghjan EPS at around 13:00 hrs, wind rose sharply in the middle of the pick. Load at 15 meter height started behaving like a pendulum and the operator held position while the rigger ran clear of the swing zone. After about two minutes the wind eased and the load was landed at the laydown without damage. Anemometer was fitted in the crane cabin but the operator was not monitoring it at all, he was going by feel. Nobody was hurt and package was fine, but the swing radius had crossed over the temporary store area where material was stacked. Now wind check is mandatory every 30 minutes during lifts and recorded in the permit, and the operator has to call out the reading to the lifting supervisor.

On 13.07.2025 at Kathalguri GCS, glycol reboiler convection section cleaning was going on with water jet. Water jet hose whipped when pump pressure surged and hose end hit near the operator's head. He ducked just in time. Jet pump was started by helper without signal from operator. Pump start not covered in permit isolation section.
Trailer hit road edge near Tengakhat in fog and tilted on soft shoulder. Two lashing belts snapped, pipes stayed because of stanchions. Crane called. Shoulder was washed out, warning board missing.
activity: casing pipe haulage by HMV trailer

text: An employee was cleaning a paint mixer. The mixer agitator/propeller caught the employee's hand, causing a fingertip [OUTCOME].

During night shift 02:15 hrs, trailer with casing pipes was reversing toward pipe rack guided by torch signals only. torch battery went weak midway, driver kept reversing on guess. trailer hit wooden sleeper stack which fell toward walkway. nobody was walking there fortunately at that time. radio communication set demanded for all night unloading jobs.

An employee was backing up a standing powered industrial vehicle (PIV) when it collided with the front of a parked PIV. One of the forks from the parked PIV struck their right lower leg, resulting in a [OUTCOME] right tibia.

During DG-4 exhaust duct inspection at Kathalguri GCS on 18.11.2025, around 11:25 hrs, the breathing air line routed across the walkway was run over by a water drum trolley, pinching it flat for some minutes. The M/s Brahmaputra Enterprise worker inside felt the supply weaken, knocked on the duct and came out safely. Walkway crossing eliminated by rerouting the line overhead and a hose-ramp kept at the crossing point.

While doing sewer chamber cleaning near Moran GGS on 27.08.2024, standby person left post to bring extra bucket from store room. Man inside chamber finished sludge removal and called for rope, no answer. He came up on corroded rungs, one rung came out in his hand, narrowly missed falling back into chamber water. Pulled himself on rim just in time. Rung repair now done before every chamber job.

Loading tubulars at Kathalguri yard, crane slings were two when bundle needed four. Middle pipes bulged out of sling grip when lifted and whole bundle bent like bow. One pipe slid out from middle and fell on ground, dug deep in soft soil. Gang was behind barricade fortunately. Bundle brought down, re-tied with pipe separators and four slings, bundle weight limit board painted at yard gate next day.

While breaking connection with lead tongs on rig #7 floor at around 02:10 hrs on 14 August 2025, tong slipped and backup man reached to steady with hand on jaw side, jaws snapped on glove edge. He ripped his hand out before the jaws took grip. Pinch point, steadying with hand instead of tong pole. Tongs with pole handles arranged.

A photographer was walking through a studio toward the production table during a photoshoot. The photographer tripped on a power cord that was taped in place on the floor with a cord cover. The photographer fell, [OUTCOME] her right hip, and was [OUTCOME].

Pilot air inspirator cleaning at Kathalguri: isolation sheet mentioned gas and power, but the inspirator's air line comes from the utility air manifold added two years back. Air blasted dust out of the open inspirator into the cleaner's face. Eyes were protected, thankfully. Air source added to the sheet.

415V panel maintenance work at Naharkatiya GGS-3 on 13.03.2025. Incoming cable box of panel opened for lug crimping. Cable was spare but landed on live busbar other end for future use. Crimping tool closed on cable insulation and tool handle touched cable lug — lug was live at 415V. Flash came at tool joint. He was wearing arc-rated gloves luckily given new that month. Spare cables now disconnected from live busbar till commissioning.

Paint stripping with heat gun near Moran GCS detection zone on 16.06.2025, 10:25 hrs, humid after rain. Heat gun kept tripping the supply. Painter bypassed the trip with wire direct connection. Trip kept coming because gun coil was failing. HSE saheb on round saw the bypass and stopped everything. Gun replaced. Bypass of protection is serious violation. M/s Duliajan Fabricators informed in writing.

Roof gutter line at GGS-2 pump house used by painters to hook their safety line, gutter is sheet metal edge only. During pulling, hook cut the gutter and line came free while painter was leaning. He fell back on the roof, not over. Anchor moved to ridge beam through drilled eye bolt by fitter same day. Eye bolt now permanent.
An employee was breaking down a display table. He jumped on the table to break it down further, fell off the table, and sustained a [OUTCOME] femur.

An employee was checking out a customer at the register. She grabbed the hand scanner and went to walk around. When she turned, she lost her balance and fell to the floor on her left side. She sustained a [OUTCOME] hip and required [OUTCOME].

Old rope tying sleeper stack broke during forklift travel at Kathalguri, sleepers scattered on road. One rolled and hit parked scooter, mirror broke. Sleepers moved by trailer afterwards. Material route and scooter parking separated.

While doing glycol reboiler level gauge isolation at Baghjan EPS on 18.11.2024, technician found gauge valves were not the ones shown in list. Modification had relocated the gauge to other nozzle last year. He almost opened the wrong nozzle on live vessel. Physical verification done before work. List corrected with modification number.
