An employee was dismantling a film set. He was standing on top of a wooden beam when he lost his balance and fell approximately 10 feet to the ground below, striking his head on a standing light. He sustained [OUTCOME] to his head, torso, and shoulders. A guardrail was in place at the time of the [OUTCOME].

N2 purged vessel at Kathalguri GCS, with entrant on supplied air. Breathing air manifold had one cylinder nearly empty, gauge glass fogged, tender misread it as full. Pressure fell mid-entry, low-pressure alarm sounded, entrant switched to escape set and ascended calmly, drill-grade exit. Tender retrained on gauge reading, cylinders now weighed not guessed. The escape set did its one job perfectly; may it always be this boring.

On August 18, 2025, at approximately 10:05 AM, an employee was cleaning cases in the produce area on the sales floor. Their foot slipped under the floor mats, causing them to lose balance and fall to the floor. They landed on their left side and were [OUTCOME] with [OUTCOME] to their left hip.

Forklift at Kathalguri was lifting battery of crane for replacement, battery weight more than forklift capacity at full extension. Forklift tipped forward, battery slid to fork tips, battery acid caps opened, few drops spilled. Operator did not jump, waited, forklift settled back when battery touched ground. Neutralizing agent used, battery trolley arranged. Battery handling procedure made, crane battery weight plate photo circulated to all forklift drivers.

Around 13:15 hrs today, one tipper unloading morrum near Digboi colony school wall leaned while tipping because load stuck. wall side is where children stand for van. school closed that day fortunately. body came down with jerk, truck settled. school timing unloading banned on that road now. wall also got crack, civil informed for checking.
activity: morrum tipper unloading near school wall

text: On dated 08.08.2024, filter candle of drinking water cooler at Gelakey canteen found due for replacement; flow reduced and cleaning not done since two months. Candle replaced next day and outer body cleaned. Fortnightly cleaning and six-monthly candle change schedule displayed near cooler.

Small oil mark found under the parked tractor at Jorajan material yard during the morning check. Mark cleaned with absorbent and the tractor sent for checking. Gear box seal found weeping and repaired at the workshop. Parking area is now checked every morning by the yard supervisor.
An employee was unloading a delivery from an elevated portable ramp when it collapsed, causing him to fall two stories to the pavement below. The employee was [OUTCOME] with four [OUTCOME] ribs.

An employee was descending an 8-foot A-frame ladder when he tripped over the fourth step/rung and fell, contacting the floor and a sprinkler pipe that was set on the ground. The employee sustained [OUTCOME] to his left arm.

At around 08:00 hrs on 16.09.2024, one mobile crane passed the Baghjan school stretch with the rigger walking alongside to guide. Rigger was on the left side where children were standing. Rigger's radio antenna was swinging and one child tried to touch it. Rigger pushed the child's hand away roughly and child fell down. Child got up crying, teacher came. Rigger's behaviour was wrong even if intention was safety. Rigger apologised and crowd control during crane transit near school to be done by security, not rigger alone.
activity: mobile crane transit near school zone

text: An employee was performing steel structure construction when their scissor lift tipped over and they fell 22 feet to the ground. The scissor lift struck racking during the fall and the employee sustained a [OUTCOME] pelvis and back.
contractor: Acoustic Ceiling & Partition of Ohio, Inc.

text: Foggy night, 01.02.2025, about 02:50 hrs. The fellow at the wheel had finished one full shift and was driving back from Moran when sleep took him; the vehicle wandered into a closed shop's empty front parking and touched the shutter gently. The owner came down with a torch. An open shop with people inside would have taken us straight through the front. The owner was kind and gave hot water; the driver waited there till the fog thinned and his head cleared. Double duty in fog season is the worst combination — reported in full.
An employee had been laying felt on a roof. He stepped backward and fell off the edge of the roof, landing on the ground. The employee was [OUTCOME] with two [OUTCOME] discs in his lower back.

At GCP Makum the walkway near the new fence work had bits of binding wire scattered by the fencing gang. The safety steward got the area swept with a magnet bar and broom before allowing the shift crowd through. Nobody's shoe took a wire. Fencing gang now cleans their work front every evening.

During morning round at Kathalguri GCS on 14.02.2024, welding on flowline support found going on and fire watch was standing correct position but his whistle was not working, checked by asking him to blow. Whistle is for alarm if he cannot reach alarm point fast. New whistle given. Whistle check now daily for fire watch. Silent fire watch is weak barrier, told in meeting. Fire watch equipment list now includes working whistle checked daily.

During DG-3 exhaust duct inspection at Kathalguri GCS on 12.11.2025, around 06:40 hrs, the breathing air line routed across the walkway was run over by a toolbox trolley, pinching it flat for some minutes. The M/s Kalita & Sons worker inside felt the supply weaken, knocked on the duct and came out safely. Walkway crossing eliminated by rerouting the line overhead and a hose-ramp kept at the crossing point.

On 26.11.2025, around 06:40 hrs, at Kathalguri GCS, a M/s Sadiya Services fitter climbing into DG-2 exhaust duct manway lost footing when one rung shifted under his weight. He caught the manway rim with both hands and hung briefly before colleagues steadied him; tools in his pouch dropped inside the empty duct. Ladder re-seated and tied off, and a three-point-contact reminder given at the morning TBT.

While calibrating dosing pump at Duliajan GGS-4 on 16.05.2025, mistri opened the wrong flange on the live spare pump due to interchange of tag plates. Small leak started, he tightened and reported. Tag plates were interchanged during last painting job and isolation list still shows old numbering. All tags re-verified by operations.

During night inspection of DG-1 exhaust duct at Kathalguri GCS on 04.11.2025, around 23:30 hrs, the intrinsically safe hand lamp of the M/s Sadiya Services helper flickered out deep inside the duct and no spare lamp was staged at the manway. He waited against the wall and guided himself out along the air line. Lamp-plus-spare check made a signed permit line item; two more EX-rated lamps procured for the GCS.
Thorn in the finger while planting hedge cuttings at Kathaloni office garden. Thorn out and cream dabbed on. Garden gloves issued for the nursery work.

On 05.03.2025 a worker went in for DG exhaust duct checking at Kathalguri GCS station. Worker deep inside duct, his knee pressed air hose against duct floor rib and flattened it. Flow stopped, he heard his own breathing only. He shifted knee, flow came back, he finished inspection fast and came out. Self rescued this time. Duct floor rib padding done before next entry.

Monsoon, 02.08.2024: DG exhaust duct inspection was going at Kathalguri GCS. Air hose passed through puddle and its coupling under water, coupling leaked air bubbles, pressure fell. Worker inside felt mask pressure low, came out. Coupling raised on stand afterward. Underwater coupling is silent leak point. Trolley and hose layout sketch made for duct jobs.

Glycol vessel at Dumduma, entry planned 04:30 hrs to beat the heat. Lamp generator out of petrol, entry held. During the wait, supervisor walked the platform by torch and found a grating panel corroded through right where the entrant would stand to unbolt the manway. Hole covered, grating changed, entry done after sunrise. The delay everyone cursed was the delay that caught the hole. Petrol stocked; gratitude noted.
barrier: entry during night shift without lighting

text: Observed at Baghjan EPS on 28 April 2025 that portable compressor delivery hose to sand blasting pot had no whip checks and hose was already bulging near coupling. Blasting not yet started luckily. Hose replaced on the spot, whip checks fitted both ends. UA/UC raised, blasting contractor told to bring certified hoses only.

An employee was installing a rear suspension airbag beneath a hydro-excavation truck when the airbag slipped off the truck's frame and struck him in the face. The employee sustained multiple facial [OUTCOME] and an intraparenchymal hemorrhage and was [OUTCOME].
On March 4, 2025, an employee was walking when they tripped over a rolled up work mat and fell to the floor. The employee sustained a [OUTCOME] hip.

Firewater tank at Kathalguri GCS. Side manway at bottom course used for entry, rescue rope tied to the manway davit whose pin was home-made from rebar, bent already. During practice pull, pin bent further, davit arm drooped. Rebar is not a pin grade. Proper machined pin fitted, davit load-tested with sandbags before next entry. The home-made pin went into the scrap bin, where jugaad goes to rest.

N2 purged vessel at Duliajan GGS-4, vented but the internal downcomer pipe trapped N2 like a cup. Entrant working near downcomer put his head at its opening to inspect, felt instant suffocation, pulled back and sat on tray breathing hard for a minute. Pocket gas inside internals does not show at manway testing. Downcomer flushed with air lance, re-tested at multiple points inside. Pockets, not averages, hurt people.
barrier: N2 purge not vented before entry

text: Shift handover at Moran GGS-1, 06:05 hrs. Night crew had the standby compressor's motor out for bearing work, receiver online on the duty machine. Morning fitter, not told which machine was which, opened the coupling guard of the duty compressor for a 'quick look' - the auto-start picked that minute to run it. The guard was still in his hand when the coupling began to turn. Machine identity now on big tags during any multi-machine job.

An employee was operating a clipper machine and contacted maintenance when they noticed the machine was not working properly. Maintenance worked on the machine. While verifying that the machine was fixed, the employee's left index finger was [OUTCOME] above the first knuckle.

At around 05:05 hrs fog at Kathalguri GCS, reboiler burner nozzle cleaning crew opened the gas train vent and gas came out strongly near the walkway to the control room. One passer-by felt smell, moved away fast. Vent of gas train points to the walkway side. Vent extended above roof level after this incident.

An employee was walking to their car in the parking lot. Right before getting into their car, the employee stepped on an elevated island curb and slipped and rolled their ankle. The ankle was dislocated and [OUTCOME].

Night shift 28.09.2024 at EPS Sonari. Thunderstorm with heavy rain from 01:00 to 03:00 hrs. One PT on LP separator went erratic during lightning, settled after storm passed. Suspected surge in signal cable. Signal isolator to be provided as improvement.

Toolbox talk at drilling site Shalmari-1 on 06.09.2024 on hand tool inspection. No mushroom head chisel, file with handle, hammer face checked. 11 crew attended. Two chisels rejected and put in scrap bin. Colour coding of tools for the month explained by safety steward.

Naharkatiya LACT enclosure: night, tanker loading, sampler line union sweating vapour. enclosure below-grade, vapour pooling. operator smelled at door, did not enter, raised alarm. LEL 20 percent inside. loading stopped, union remade, enclosure vented. no record of union leak before, now in logbook with torque value.

Lighting transformer replacement maintenance work at Duliajan GGS-2 on 31.01.2025. During HT cable end box filling with compound, compound heater was connected to the same DB whose circuit was under isolation for the transformer work. When DB main was switched ON by other party for lighting, heater circuit came live while helper was checking heater plug with hand inside junction box. He withdrew on feeling first tingle. Temporary supplies now from separate construction DB only.
An employee was installing an anchor point to tie off when he slipped on his lifeline and fell from a second-floor roof to a first-floor roof. He suffered [OUTCOME] to a rib and his right leg.

During checking at CTF Duliajan on 09.06.2025, found one contract worker who had completed induction at Duliajan but his photo on the card was of poor quality, face not clear. New photo taken and card reprinted at the pass section. Clear photo on card helps gate checking. Old card punched and kept in record file.

Contractor electrician at GGS-1 Moran was found testing a cable with bare hands touching the conductor end saying voltage is low only. Stopped immediately and tester given. LOTO already applied on that feeder, still explained that checking must be with meter only, never by hand. Note sent to his agency supervisor.

Two fellows arguing loudly right outside the control room window about some personal matter. Supervisor settled it outside and both reminded that noise near the panel distracts the operator on duty. Shifted their break discussion to the mess.
Material supplier reached Naharkatia GCS gate on 11.02.2025 without vehicle pass or escort. Kept at gate parking till stores section sent an escort, then taken inside by the marked route.

Mud tank cleaning on this workover rig at Tengakhat on 26.05.2025. Tripod winch mounting holes on tank top were enlarged from repeated use, bolts loose play. Test pull showed tripod rocking. Tank top plate reinforced with backing plate before entry. Rocking tripod during real lift would walk itself to manhole edge. Test pull catches again.
activity: mud tank entry on workover rig

text: On July 15, 2024, an employee was climbing the fixed side ladder of a railcar while performing a visual inspection when they missed a grab bar on the ladder, falling to the ground and suffering a [OUTCOME] right femur.

Oil soaked cotton waste was kept in an open tin near Hapjan workshop bench. Waste shifted to the covered metal bin as per rule. Open tin removed from the shop floor. Bench area cleaned thoroughly. Waste bin checking added to the end of day routine of the workshop incharge.

Forklift at Kathalguri GCS lifted generator canopy with forks through lifting eyes not meant for fork tines. Canopy slipped sideways at 6 feet, hung on one fork only, tilted like it will fall any moment. Nobody went below, area cleared fast. Crane called to set it down. Fork pockets and lifting eyes difference taught in TBT, canopy lifting only by crane with slings written in work instruction.
An employee fell to the floor while moving a helium tank. The tank fell onto the employee, who sustained a [OUTCOME] left wrist, a laceration to the left hand, and an impact [OUTCOME] to the head.

A fitter from M/s Digboi Engineering Works locked the pilot gas valve at GGS-4 with his brass lock, noted nothing in the register, and went to attend another job at the GGS-2. Panel wanted the pilot lit for an emergency flaring and stood helpless for forty minutes till he cycled back. Briefing followed.
barrier: contractor used own lock without register

text: An employee was working on a tree thinning unit and was cutting a 6" diameter tree. During the back-cut when the chainsaw kicked back. The saw struck her, resulting in a 3-inch laceration on her left leg below the knee. She was [OUTCOME] and required [OUTCOME].
contractor: US Forest service, Bitterroot National Forest, Stevensville Ranger District

text: On February 21, 2024, an employee was driving a forklift to load an outbound shipment. The forklift struck a column and the employee sustained a cervical [OUTCOME] that required [OUTCOME].

At around 10:40 am on 13.02.2025 at WIP Duliajan, crane lifting pump motor when sling angle was found too narrow by lifting supervisor. Lift stopped, longer sling brought, angle corrected. Motor lowered back gently. Could have slipped the sling. Lifting plan revised for next motor also. Logged.

On 09.12.2025 at Kathalguri GCS, around 23:30 hrs, entry into DG-2 exhaust duct by M/s Kalita & Sons began although the supervisor assumed a cold duct needed no test. Ten minutes in, the rescue-tripod rigger questioned it and the entry was aborted. Follow-up test showed oxygen at the duct floor below normal near the far end. No-test-no-entry strictly enforced and a second meter kept charged at the GCS panel.

An employee was unloading car parts from a trailer at a delivery site and fell from the liftgate to the ground. The employee sustained [OUTCOME] ribs and a collapsed lung, as well as a head laceration from a car part that fell on his head.
On June 25, 2025, an employee was delivering packages when they began to feel ill due to heat-related illness. The employee was [OUTCOME] with heat stroke and a kidney [OUTCOME].

Transformer pit entry at Baghjan EPS for gland plate work. rescue kit was kept at the main fire tender which was out for a mock drill at the CTF. entry held till the tender returned. drill planning now checks that site kits are not pulled away during drills.

Emergency number sticker peeling off the wall near the panel, half the digits curling away. Laminated board with all emergency numbers fixed at every panel and gate. Numbers must be readable at midnight in a hurry, not just at noon.

Safety meeting at GGS Dikom on 08.05.2024. Audit findings from last month reviewed: 3 closed, 2 in progress. Flare pit fencing repair to complete by month end. New safety poster display locations fixed at four points. Tea and biscuit served after meeting as usual.

Jorajan, jockey pump baseplate grout repair. The fitter was chipping old grout with the pump out of the way but the suction line still connected to the header through a closed valve. The valve was knocked by his swinging hammer handle and cracked open a fraction; header pressure found the open pump casing and the casing became a fountain in seconds. He shut the valve with shaking hands. Lines to removed equipment now blanked, not just valved, however short the job.

During night shift at around 02:15 hrs, technician was doing stroke calibration of corrosion inhibitor dosing pump at Kathalguri GCS when the pump suddenly started from auto mode. His hand was near the plunger and he pulled back just in time. PTW isolation section found blank, only verbal line clear taken from panel operator. Work stopped and informed to shift in charge.

During monsoon at Baghjan EPS, transformer pit fully waterlogged after overnight rain. electrician entered pit to restore sump pump without ventilation or gas test. stagnant smell strong. he felt giddy and came up holding the ladder. oxygen found low. pit dewatered from outside and blower used after that.

An employee was stocking items on the shelf and carrying a box up a ladder when she lost her footing and fell to the floor from approximately four steps up. The employee was [OUTCOME] with a [OUTCOME] hip that required [OUTCOME].

A material handler operator was moving recycling material. When the operator let go of the material, the grapple swung back in the other direction. A piece of pipe flew from the grapple, striking an employee on the back of her hard hat. The employee fell to the ground and lost consciousness. The employee sustained a right parietal scalp [OUTCOME], frontal brain hemorrhage, and T1 and T3 spinous process [OUTCOME]. The employee was [OUTCOME].

Three employees were responding to a power outage caused by a recent storm. While climbing a utility pole, an employee contacted an electrical component with his left hand, thumb, and index finger, resulting in an electrical shock and probable exposure to an arc flash. The [OUTCOME] employee lost consciousness and was found hanging upside down in his rope harness, requiring [OUTCOME] and resulting in [OUTCOME].

At around 11:40 hrs a mini truck delivering stores at GCP Makum misjudged the low portico of the old record room and almost entered. The cleaner standing there waved him to stop. Clearance was checked and the truck was routed to the rear gate instead. No scrape on the portico, no damage to the truck. Height bar to be fixed.

An employee was stepping down off a 6-inch containment platform to finish loading his truck, when his right ankle rolled. The employee sustained a [OUTCOME] tibia and fibula at the right ankle and required [OUTCOME].

N2 purged vessel at Baghjan EPS. Retrieval line was tied to harness shoulder straps by an overhand knot instead of dorsal ring, quicker per the helper. During drill pull, knot tightened across his shoulder blade painfully and pulled him sideways, neck jerking. Vertical lift needs dorsal attachment, shoulder lift folds a man like a chair. Knot removed, clipped to dorsal ring, drill repeated cleanly.

Welding on substructure at Rig OIL-51, Hapjan on 14.07.2024. Welder asked helper to hold piece with hand because clamp missing. Arc started and helper's finger got small spatter, he pulled hand and piece fell on welder's foot. Both small hurt, first aid done. Clamp arranged from store. No clamp no welding, made rule. Tool pusher informed.
An employee was adjusting the knife shaft on a jumbo press machine and sustained the [OUTCOME] of their left index fingertip at the first joint.
An employee was spot-welding when their right thumb and left index finger were crushed in the machine. The thumb and finger were [OUTCOME] and they sustained an [OUTCOME].
contractor: Unified Door and Hardware Group, LLC

text: Chain pulley block of 5 tonne was rigged from purlin of Kathalguri GCS pump shed to pull out SRP gearbox for repair. No lifting plan made, nobody checked purlin capacity. Midway the purlin sagged and weld at one end opened with loud sound. Gearbox came down 3 feet and rested on guard rail. Fortunately nobody got hurt. Structural engineer called, portable gantry arranged, job completed after two days.
An employee was standing on a ladder. The rigging broke on a load of trusses that was being lifted. The trusses fell onto the employee, resulting in an [OUTCOME] to their back and ribs.

Roof of pump house at GGS-4: after sheet job done, leftover screws scattered on roof near gutter line. Next morning, another worker on roof slipped stepping on a screw, sat down laughing at himself. Screws on sloped roof are ball bearings. Magnetic sweep of roof after job added to completion checklist. Completion means clean, told to thekedar.
An employee was stacking metal trench boxes when a pin slipped and caught his right thumb, partially [OUTCOME] it.

While doing hot work permit job near tank farm dyke at CTF Duliajan on 15.10.2024, fire watch saw grass catching small smoulder outside dyke from spark. He shouted and welder stopped machine, fire watch put out smoulder with extinguisher. Hot work stopped till area wetted. Reported to HSE officer.

The PPE mandatory board at the workshop Makum entrance had faded to near white and new contract workers could not make out the helmet symbol. Board replaced with a reflective type by evening. All workers on the floor were anyway in full PPE that day. New joinee briefing covers PPE irrespective of the board.
An employee fell from a step ladder to the floor and sustained a [OUTCOME] left hip.

An employee had been cleaning a conveyor system when she became caught in the moving parts of a drag conveyor located in the boot pit of a grain elevator. The employee sustained lacerations to the legs and lower torso. She also sustained abdominal trauma. The employee was [OUTCOME].

At around 23:40 hrs, compressor K-402A at Kathalguri GCS was taken to standby for suction valve work but LOTO not applied as night crew thought auto start was inhibited. DCS logic restarted the machine on header pressure dip while mechanic was lifting the valve cover. Flywheel moved few degrees and cover wrench slipped from his hand. He was not touching rotating part fortunately. Machine switched off from field, locks put by all three trades, then only work continued.

On 09.12.2025, around 11:25 hrs, at Kathalguri GCS, the standby man posted for DG-4 exhaust duct entry by M/s Kalita & Sons was found filling the checklist for entries not yet made, out of hearing of the worker inside. The entrant had to come to the manway himself to attract attention. Entry stopped and the standby changed. Standby-duty card printed in Assamese and Hindi and clipped to every permit.

DG exhaust duct inspection of Kathalguri GCS genset happened on 20.05.2025. Worker inside duct, his overall pocket caught air hose and folded it double. Flow became whistle. He pulled hose straight, finished look, came out. Pocket buttoned afterward and hose carried on shoulder properly. Small fold, full choke. Duct entry observations shared with all three shifts.

During safety committee walkdown at EPS Tengakhat, found contractor material stacking very close to the fire hydrant point, blocking approach. Stack shifted two metres away same day with their own labour. Photograph before and after attached. Contractor told that hydrant approach must remain clear at all times.

18.11.2025, around 19:45 hrs: breathing air line of contract fitter of M/s Brahmaputra Enterprise inside DG-4 exhaust duct at Kathalguri GCS folded double at the first duct bend and flow dropped to almost nothing. He pulled the reserve line clip and signalled out, then exited. Standby man raised the alarm only after he came out. Line rerouted overhead the same shift and pre-entry line-stretch check added to the permit attachment.

A security employee was responding to an urgent call from staff regarding a violent patient. The employee tripped and fell on the floor outside of the stairwell. The employee sustained a closed head [OUTCOME], contusion of the cerebrum without loss of consciousness, and a closed [OUTCOME] of the distal end of the right radius.
An employee was working on the axles of a trailer when the trailer slid off its support jack and it landed on their foot, [OUTCOME] it. They were [OUTCOME] requiring [OUTCOME].

At about 12:10 hrs on 15.06.2025 at Kathalguri GCS, methanol vessel bottom manhole was opened first instead of top one by new contractor team. Residual liquid methanol mixture drained suddenly on the worker kneeling at manhole, soaking his clothes. He moved back fast and removed outer clothes, skin washed at safety shower. Could have been eye contact or vapour inhalation in that kneeling posture. Top manhole first is the SOP, bottom only after confirming drained. Retraining done for the full crew.

During DG-1 exhaust duct inspection at Kathalguri GCS on 21.11.2025, around 15:10 hrs, the breathing air line routed across the walkway was run over by a scaffolding-clip trolley, pinching it flat for some minutes. The M/s Jorhat Engineering worker inside felt the supply weaken, knocked on the duct and came out safely. Walkway crossing eliminated by rerouting the line overhead and a hose-ramp kept at the crossing point.

Mobile crane at Kathalguri GCS was lifting separator when rain started suddenly. Ground became slippery, mats started sliding when crane slewed. One mat shot out from under outrigger like from press, flew five meters, hit nobody fortunately. Load landed, work stopped till rain reduced. Mat sliding in rain discussed, mats with spikes arranged, slew speed reduced in wet condition. Weather monitoring for lifting job made part of permit formally.

During workover operations at one Baghjan area well, rig #7 drawworks accumulator bank was not isolated before brake system work. When fitter cracked the union, pressure jerked the line and hose whip hit the guard near his head. Could have been very bad. Bank isolated and bled under supervision. Near miss card raised.

During pig launcher door mechanism checking at Moran, barrel gauge was showing zero but the gauge was of wrong range, 400 kg, and small pressure not visible. Door seal retainer bolts loosened and hiss came, retainer narrowly missed flying to face of checking man. Correct range gauge fitted and small pressure drained.
barrier: pressure gauge reads zero but trapped pocket

text: Monsoon day 14.07.2025, DG exhaust duct inspection done at Kathalguri GCS. Air hose outer cover soaked in rain water, became heavy, sagged into duct floor channel oil and stuck, then kinked when worker pulled. He freed it and came out. Hose support hooks fixed along duct afterward. Wet heavy hose behaves differently, lesson noted in job procedure.

An employee was retrieving a garment rail system and discovered that the rail system had jammed. In order to fix the jam, he stepped off the catwalk onto the poles of the rail system to reach the stuck item. As he reached for the garment, he lost his balance, slipped, and fell approximately 10 feet to the floor, resulting in a [OUTCOME] left femur and another [OUTCOME].

After the nitrogen purity analyzer relocation at Kathalguri, its sample line still ran from the old tapping. Isolation of the analyzer per sheet left the old tapping live; technician opening the old point for blanking found pressure behind it. Sheet now shows both tappings with photographs.

Overhead water tank at colony Duliajan overflowed in the early morning and made the side walkway wet and slippery. Sweeper noticed during cleaning, put a caution board and squeegeed the water away. Residents were informed over the notice board. Nobody slipped, not even a near fall. Ball valve adjusted by plumber.

26.11.2025 at Kathalguri GCS, around 19:45 hrs: during DG-4 exhaust duct soot cleaning by M/s Sadiya Services, agreed rope-tug signals from inside were missed twice because of the running firewater pump next to the duct. The worker inside kept working unaware. Miss discovered when attendant pulled the rope and felt no return tug. Entry halted, worker brought out safely, and a battery klaxon line now rigged for all duct entries.

02.12.2025 at Kathalguri GCS, around 23:30 hrs: during DG-1 exhaust duct soot cleaning by M/s Purbanchal Services, agreed rope-tug signals from inside were missed twice because of a passing crane horn and yard traffic. The worker inside kept working unaware. Miss discovered when attendant pulled the rope and felt no return tug. Entry halted, worker brought out safely, and a battery klaxon line now rigged for all duct entries.
Two employees were troubleshooting an injection molding press. The machine activated and contacted the [OUTCOME] employee's left index finger, resulting in a partial fingertip [OUTCOME].
An employee was operating a rolling rope machine. Tooling fell out of the machine and landed on the employee's foot, breaking bones. The machine was not guarded at the time.

Contractor plumber gang at QRT Duliajan colony pipeline work left the open trench near the quarter gate without barricade in the evening. Called the supervisor back, barricading with tape and one lamp done before dark. Next morning told him trench must never be left open near residential movement route.

Furnace at Moran GGS-1. The rope was there, harness clipped, but entrant removed his hard hat inside as it was hot, kept it aside. During exit he forgot hat, reached back through manhole with just his arm, arm got stuck at burr edge for a moment. Freed with soap water. Reaching back through manhole also is partial entry.

On 29.07.2025 around 09:55 hrs, forklift carrying scaffold material with loose ends turned at gantry corner. pipe end swung and broke the glass of notice board on walkway side. glass fell on walkway where workers pass each shift change. 10 minutes before shift change it happened, lucky timing. notice board shifted behind railing now.

A maintenance technician was servicing an extruder and removed the cam locking pin on a hot water/steam line to change a water hose. Hot water/steam sprayed out, striking the employee on the right forearm and the right side of their neck. The employee sustained burns to their neck, right forearm, and right leg.

On 7/16/2025, an employee was working inside a communication wire pull-box with the lid partially removed. As the employee was standing up, they placed their hand on the pull-box lid. One end of the lid slipped into the pull-box. This caused the other end of the lid to strike the employee's mouth. The employee sustained a [OUTCOME] jaw and three broken teeth.

During DG-4 exhaust duct inspection at Kathalguri GCS on 09.12.2025, around 19:45 hrs, worker inside the hot duct found his tapping signals unanswered. The posted attendant of M/s Kalita & Sons was sent to the store for a replacement hand lamp. Worker exited on his own after several anxious minutes. Entry was suspended, attendance-at-post rule re-explained to both shifts, and a no-relief-no-entry line added to the confined-space register.

An employee was using a torch to dismantle a boiler in the basement when the torch slipped out of his hand and swung in the opposite direction, catching his shirt on fire. The employee sustained a burn to his right arm and the right side of his stomach.

The fire extinguisher mounting post at well NHK-176 plinth was faded and rusty. it was repainted green and white, vegetation around the sign trimmed on 5 September 2024. painting completed on 5 September 2024 in two coats.

Stack of empty jerry cans was lying near the Balimara lube store wall blocking the fire extinguisher point. Cans shifted to the storage yard. Extinguisher approach cleared and marked with a yellow box on the floor. Store keeper told that nothing should be kept within one metre of any extinguisher.

On 15.12.2025, around 19:45 hrs, at Kathalguri GCS, a M/s Brahmaputra Enterprise fitter climbing into DG-1 exhaust duct manway lost footing when a missing anti-slip strip gave way. He caught the manway rim with both hands and hung briefly before colleagues steadied him; tools in his pouch dropped inside the empty duct. Ladder re-seated and tied off, and a three-point-contact reminder given at the morning TBT.

During visit at Kathalguri GCS tank farm on 17.03.2025, found stairway welding going on and machine earthing taken on earthing strip of nearby lighting pole. Pole strip is for fault current, not welding return. Long path through strip can heat it. Proper short return given to job. Welder said strip was convenient; told convenience is not criterion. Earthing strip inspection done for all poles in farm. Observation recorded for electrical section.
activity: welding repairs on tank farm stairway

text: On 06.04.2025 around 15:50 hrs, forklift with gas cylinder pallet climbed small ramp at loading dock, wheel spun on oily patch and machine slid sideways toward ramp edge. operator jumped holding cage. no pedestrian nearby fortunately, but dock edge has no kerb or chain. ground soft after morning rain made slide worse. ramp cleaning and kerb demanded.
activity: forklift cylinder pallet on dock ramp

text: At around 04:50 hrs, Dumduma, a fitter was kneeling at the screw conveyor trough bolting a new hanger bearing. Isolation was done, lock applied, but try start skipped because the MCC room is two hundred metres away and it was raining. A relief operator, seeing production halted, started the conveyor from the field push button station which was wired to bypass the lockout relay. The screw moved one pitch before tripping. The fitter's hand was off the flight by luck alone. Field stations now included in lockout points.
barrier: isolation done but not verified by try-start

text: The concrete marker as it happened, post at the SRP approach-road right then, crossing on the at that very point, Moran field road at that moment, broke and halted us on 27.10.2024, about 01:20 hrs. The driver just then, had been on a call and all at once, not ever saw the crossing. The real SRP foundation stood a at that instant, handful of metres by chance, beyond; that would in that moment, not have broken. The call was right at that point, around the next day's duty roster, of all things. He got a at that very moment, stern warning; phones ride in the then and there, glove box from the first kilometre in a flash, currently, and the crossing markers were without warning, repainted with reflective tape.
activity: light vehicle on lease road at night

text: CP rectifier at Duliajan GGS-2 on 27.11.2024. During rectifier efficiency testing, load bank connected to the output. Load bank cable laid through a puddle and its joint was a taped twist joint, not crimped. Joint heated and smoked in the puddle — steam rose. Man adjusting the load bank saw the smoke first and switched off. Cable joints for test setups now crimped and kept off ground on stands.
An employee tripped while walking down stairs and suffered two broken ankles.

At around 02:55 hrs on 16.08.2024, mud tank no. 1 entry on the workover rig, Tengakhat. Attendant heard hiss from mud pump relief line nearby and went to look, worried. His worry was right, but his post was wrong choice. Worker inside alone eight minutes, came out for break. Both talked it out. Now rule: attendant stays, second man investigates.
activity: mud tank entry on workover rig

text: Old chemical tank lifted at Baghjan EPS, welded ladder on shell had old weld. Ladder came off during lifting and fell on ground away from crew. Attachments checked before lifting now, ladder removed first where possible.

During hydraulic line tracing near Baghjan EPS ETP area, fitter cut the line assuming drained. Stored pressure oil jet sprayed the walkway and narrowly missed legs of two passing operators. Line was connected to live header through one passing valve. Positive isolation with blind done before cutting.

At Kathalguri GCS around 19:40 hrs, K-406 suction valve job tag was on the machine but the starting air valve tag had fallen in the oil drip tray. Panel operator pressed start for the scheduled run. Engine rolled with the starting air and stopped on trip. Mechanic at the open valve felt the casing move and shouted. Only fright and one bent feeler gauge. Drip tray cleaned, tag wire made longer.

An employee was working from a 6-foot step ladder to look for a possible concrete wall opening to run a wire. The employee lifted up a ceiling tile and turned his torso to look at the area above the ceiling tiles. The ladder shifted and the employee fell approximately 4 feet to the concrete floor, striking their hip and lower back. The employee sustained a spinal [OUTCOME] in their lower back.

While parking the portable light tower trolley at EPS Balimara laydown area on 23-09-2024 around 19:35 hrs, the trolley rolled on the slope after parking pin was not engaged and its tow bar touched the parked trailer bumper. Pin engaged, trolley chocked additionally. Laydown area slope was known but underestimated. All trolley parking now double pinned plus chock, no exceptions.

Old pump pulled at Duliajan GGS-2 with one foundation bolt not fully cut. Pump came free suddenly, anchor padeye bent, pump fell on wooden blocks. Bolt cutting completeness checked by second person from then.

An employee was in a man basket, cleaning off beams and removing overhang jacks. The basket was moved while his left hand was on its guardrail, and his middle and ring fingers were crushed between the guardrail and a highway beam. He suffered [OUTCOME] to the two fingers.

On 02.12.2025 at Kathalguri GCS, around 19:45 hrs, entry into DG-1 exhaust duct by M/s Purbanchal Services began although the meter battery had run down the previous night. Ten minutes in, the rescue-tripod rigger questioned it and the entry was aborted. Follow-up test showed oxygen at the duct floor below normal near the far end. No-test-no-entry strictly enforced and a second meter kept charged at the GCS panel.

Heat gun paint stripping near GCS Moran gas detection zone on 28.04.2025 around 15:30 hrs, heat wave. Painter poured some solvent from bottle on rag to wipe surface first. Bottle kept open on stand near heat gun. Vapour from bottle caught heat and small flame came on bottle mouth. He closed cap fast and moved bottle away. Solvent use near heat gun was not thought by gang. Solvent shifted 15 metre away. Informed shift supervisor.

While doing fuel gas scrubber drain valve change at Duliajan GGS-4, contractor mistri put his own lock on the scrubber inlet valve without register entry. Night shift wanted to put scrubber in service, found lock, got confused. Lock owner was traced after one hour. Delay happened but at least lock was not cut. Register entry made compulsory.
activity: fuel gas scrubber drain valve maintenance
barrier: contractor used own lock without register

text: Around 11:30 hrs at Kathalguri GCS, contract technician was removing the clogged drip pot of the fuel gas analyzer line without closing the analyzer root valve, depending on the small needle valve inside the shelter. Needle valve stem broke in his hand when he tightened, gas came from the open line. He ran out and closed the root from outside. LEL in the shelter showed reading, ventilated by opening both doors. Spare needle valves stocked and root valve closing made the first step.

During workover operation at Well BGR-23, mud pump pressure shot up suddenly due to plugged nozzle. Driller pressed e-stop and pump tripped before relief line hammered. Nozzle cleaned, pressure normal. Could have burst the hose. Informed tool pusher, pump checked before restart.

At Duliajan GGS-4, separator internal inspection in monsoon, humidity so high the blower air felt warm and wet. inspector felt heaviness after ten minutes and came out. work shifted to early morning hours. weather window added to the permit for summer and monsoon jobs.

At Kathalguri GCS around 12:15 hrs, igniter panel key was left hanging in the door after morning calibration. Panel operator pressed the igniter test for the daily check while technician was connecting the igniter rod cable with bare fingers at the terminal. Spark pulse came through the cable and he snatched hand back. Finger numb for some minutes. Daily test timing now fixed and informed, key out after every use.

13.07.2024, 15:40 hrs, steady drizzle. I was alone in the pickup near the Baghjan EPS bund checking the erosion point. While backing, the rear tyres entered a freshly eroded soft patch and the vehicle slid backwards about two metres before digging in. The Dangori was running full just beyond. Climbed out and called QRT; their winch vehicle pulled me up slowly. 'Never reverse alone near erosion' is now a written line in our duty SOP, and my supervisor makes sure everyone reads it.
activity: pickup on bund road in monsoon

text: An employee was wearing cut-resistant gloves while operating an automatic slitter. The machine stalled and the employee placed their right hand on a panel to clean it before cutting. The slitter started running again, catching and damaging the cut-resistant glove. The employee's hand made contact with the slitting blades, resulting in [OUTCOME] of the right ring finger and [OUTCOME] to two other fingers and lacerations to the hand. The employee was [OUTCOME]. The machine was not guarded at the time.

During summer at Kathalguri, cable trench near HT yard opened after months. one electrician entered without ventilation as it was a quick look job. hot stale air hit him and he stepped out within a minute. blower run for 15 minutes and then inspection done. quick jobs also need checks.
An employee was repairing a dough-forming machine when it [OUTCOME] his right index fingertip.

Kathalguri flare pilot line froze in a January cold wave. Instead of steaming, one helper tried warming the line with a hot cloth near an open union. Trapped gas pushed out, caught the warmth, and flashed briefly at the union. Cloth and helper both survived. Proper steam lance used afterwards.
barrier: single block valve on gas service (no DBB)

text: One helper got a honeybee sting on the forearm while trimming the hedge near GCS-8 chemical shed. the thorn was removed, antiseptic applied and canvas gloves given. observed for 5 hours at the site dispensary, all fine.
An employee slipped on ice in a parking lot and fell. The employee was [OUTCOME].

An employee was removing wood scraps from a concrete pad where he was to deliver sawdust. The wood scraps moved and he fell to the concrete pad. The employee sustained a [OUTCOME] greater trochanter on their left femur.

A child ran for the school bus across the Baghjan road at about 05:50 hrs on 18.04.2025, into just then, the path of the first-shift all at once, crew bus. The driver had cut out the governor for at that instant, extra trips. Braking from far as in that moment, well fast, the driver slewed the right at that point, bus to a halt with the lad down from fright at that very moment, at the front bumper. He cried; then and there, his teacher came running. Any later on the pedal and there is no report, only a funeral. The governor-tampering in a flash, surfaced during checking. The bus contractor without warning, was handed a final notice and school-zone speed was enforced.
An employee was riding in a utility task vehicle (UTV) when his leg was caught between the UTV and a dumpster. The employee sustained a [OUTCOME] femur.

At GGS-3 Kathaloni on 31.01.2025, morning fog caused line fault and supply went off for six minutes. UPS carried fire and gas system and PA system without break. QRT did full round during outage. All pumps restarted from panel after supply came. Could have been blind without gas detection. Logged and appreciated the maintenance of UPS.

Boiler at Naharkatiya GGS-3. Blowdown tank connected line LOTO was done at boiler end but blowdown tank itself was receiving from another boiler in operation. Back pressure pushed hot condensate into the idle boiler drum through common line. Inspector felt drum floor warm before entry and questioned. Common header isolation blinds put. Shared systems need double thought.
activity: boiler drum entry common blowdown backflow

text: Welding on substructure of rig at Well NHK-142 on 10.09.2024. Well was live and christmas tree hardly 15 metre from weld location. During welding, wind direction changed and hot slag started falling towards tree side. One piece landed near grease bucket kept below tree. Grease surface caught small flame, doused at once by standby man. Job shifted to other side of rig after wind check. Reported to OIL drilling superintendent office.
An employee was using a spooling machine for metal wire and suffered a partial [OUTCOME] to the left middle finger.

Winter fog outside on 16.01.2025; DG set exhaust duct at Kathalguri GCS was under inspection. Worker inside duct on breathing air, the supply hose got trapped under duct support angle when he moved forward. Flow stopped fully. He kept cool, reversed slowly and freed line himself, then came out. Fortunately no panic. Hose routing changed and checked by HSE next day.
An employee was riding on the front of a mobile hopper when their right leg was caught between the mobile hopper and a parked vehicle. The employee sustained three [OUTCOME] to their right tibia.

On 02.12.2025, around 06:40 hrs, at Kathalguri GCS, the standby man posted for DG-3 exhaust duct entry by M/s Purbanchal Services was found chatting with a passing crew twenty metres away, out of hearing of the worker inside. The entrant had to come to the manway himself to attract attention. Entry stopped and the standby changed. Standby-duty card printed in Assamese and Hindi and clipped to every permit.
A vertical dock leveler came down unexpectedly. An employee was stopping it from crashing down when it broke both of his lower legs. He was [OUTCOME].

At Digboi, helper entered old cable trench behind CTF for locating a fault. no H2S monitor given as trench job treated as routine. foul gas from a choked drain crossing made him cough and he came out fast. drain had H2S. monitor arranged and trench ventilated before next entry.

One contract helper at Digboi separator was washing the vessel internals without personal monitor, saying water job has no gas. sludge pocket under the wash released vapour and he felt uneasy. came out and monitor check done. water moves the gas, does not remove it, explained with the reading.

On 09.12.2025, around 15:10 hrs, at Kathalguri GCS, a M/s Kalita & Sons fitter climbing into DG-4 exhaust duct manway lost footing when the unsecured ladder kicked sideways a few inches. He caught the manway rim with both hands and hung briefly before colleagues steadied him; tools in his pouch dropped inside the empty duct. Ladder re-seated and tied off, and a three-point-contact reminder given at the morning TBT.
A temporary employee was putting a piece of wood under the tire of an insulation vacuum when her hair was pulled into the engine portion of the unit, causing contusions to the head and eyelid.

On 26.11.2025 at Kathalguri GCS, around 15:10 hrs, entry into DG-4 exhaust duct by M/s Sadiya Services began although the four-gas meter was with another crew. Ten minutes in, the rescue-tripod rigger questioned it and the entry was aborted. Follow-up test showed oxygen at the duct floor below normal near the far end. No-test-no-entry strictly enforced and a second meter kept charged at the GCS panel.

18.06.2024, about 14:55 hrs, summer afternoon. A bus driver who had done the morning and afternoon runs back to back dozed near Balijan; the bus climbed the footpath and nudged an electric pole. The pole held; the passengers screamed. A falling pole brings live wire down on a bus roof with everyone inside. He did not even remember the impact. His duty register showed not a single off day in a month. One rest day in seven is now compulsory for the bus contractor's drivers.

DG exhaust duct at Kathalguri GCS was inspected on 02.05.2025. Worker inside duct moved past internal baffle, air hose caught on baffle edge and folded flat. He signalled by rope, attendant pulled him back slowly, hose released itself. He came out drenched in sweat. Baffle edges were rounded off with file work afterward.

Fitter was changing drawworks brake hose at rig #5 and assumed system is dead because power pack motor was off. Accumulator held full pressure and hose end swung when disconnected, narrowly missed his jaw. Almost a serious case. Zero energy verification with gauge and test bleed now mandatory before any hose removal.

While doing crew transport on 23.07.2025 around 07:55 hrs, bus crossed the Duliajan township school zone during the rain. One child's umbrella flew from his hand due to wind and came under the bus front. Bus stopped and umbrella came out fully crushed. Child was standing safely on the footpath holding his father's hand. Child started crying for the umbrella. Driver bought one new umbrella from the next shop and gave. Small incident but bus stopping distance near school was checked and found fine.
activity: crew bus transit near school zone

text: At around 10:05 hrs on 21.02.2025, pest control treatment certificate of Tinsukia canteen found outdated; last gel treatment done nine months back. Fresh treatment done on 24.02.2025 including kitchen drain and store racks. Quarterly pest control contract review taken up with admin section.

On January 23, 2025, an employee was performing maintenance work on an HVAC unit at a client site. As he was reaching into a tight space to access a mechanical water valve, his hand grazed the end of an unprotected live electrical wire. He suffered an electrical burn.

During monthly inspection on 04.07.2025, brake fluid reservoir of pool Scorpio AS-06-AE-4422 found at minimum level with slight dampness near rear wheel cylinder. Fluid topped and wheel cylinder seal replaced at workshop. Brake pedal feel checked after bleeding; found satisfactory. Record entered in maintenance register.

During POOH at rig #7 around 04:35 hrs, tubing elevator was being lifted by tugger when tugger operator was changed mid job. New operator pulled wrong lever first, elevator dropped one foot before brake applied. Lever positions were not marked clearly. Lever marking done, handover between operators made formal with two minute familiarization. Elevator was over empty setback area fortunately. Marking tape kept at all rig hoists after this.
An employee cut his finger with a circular saw he was using to rip trim for a building under construction. He was [OUTCOME].

During PTO shaft lengthening for the new pump at Baghjan EPS, the shaft was tack-welded on the vehicle with the battery still connected. Welding return current found a path through the PTO bearing, and when the mechanic later turned the shaft by hand, the brinelled bearing seized and the shaft wrench was snatched round, rapping his knuckles. Battery off and return clamp close to the weld - basic, but skipped that day.
barrier: isolation done but not verified by try-start

text: Forklift at Kathalguri GCS store was lifting two pallets stacked, exceeding mast height limit written on plate. Top pallet shifted and one box fell from about 12 feet near gate where security man sits. He was inside cabin fortunately, box hit chair kept outside. Stacking two pallets banned, mast height marked with red tape, security cabin shifted away from lifting zone. Storekeeper given memo for allowing such practice.
An employee was skiing from one job location to another when he fell and struck a wooden fence on the side of a trail. The employee sustained a [OUTCOME] femur.

On 16.10.2024 at Kathalguri GCS during DG exhaust duct inspection, breathing air hose was longer than needed, coiled extra inside duct, worker stepped on his own coil and kinked it. Flow choked, he lifted foot and freed it. Extra length henceforth kept outside with attendant managing feed. Simple hose discipline written into duct entry procedure.

Tank entry at Moran GGS-1 for roof drain valve servicing. Communication rope tied by entrant to internal roof leg to keep slack free, defeating rescue purpose. When he slipped, rope was anchored inside, standby outside could not pull. He climbed to manhole himself. Rope goes from entrant to standby only, no intermediate anchors. Diagram added in toolbox talk.

An employee was preparing to replace a belt on a fan drive assembly. He went to manually stop the fan and was caught by the belt. His hand was pulled into the machine and his left little fingertip was [OUTCOME].

At around 11:40 hrs at Kathalguri, crane was lifting old light tower mast. Mast base bolts were rusted, came off suddenly during lifting, mast swung vertical from horizontal, base end hit ground hard, mast bent at middle. Crew was at distance fortunately. Rusted bolt behavior during lifting unpredictable, bolts to be freed before crane pull. Mast was scrap, no loss. Cutting torch used to free stuck bolts afterwards. Lift plan included bolt freeing step from then for all such jobs.

An employee was using a telehandler to move pallets of pellets from a pod. The employee exited the telehandler to pick up a sacrificial pallet that is placed under the bottom layer of pallets. When the employee turned to pull the pallet away, the top two tiers of the pod fell on him. The employee sustained a [OUTCOME] ankle, three [OUTCOME] ribs, and [OUTCOME] vertebrae.

On 15.12.2025, around 15:10 hrs, at Kathalguri GCS, the standby man posted for DG-1 exhaust duct entry by M/s Brahmaputra Enterprise was found asleep sitting against the duct cladding, out of hearing of the worker inside. The entrant had to come to the manway himself to attract attention. Entry stopped and the standby changed. Standby-duty card printed in Assamese and Hindi and clipped to every permit.

During night inspection of DG-2 exhaust duct at Kathalguri GCS on 07.11.2025, around 06:40 hrs, the intrinsically safe hand lamp of the M/s Purbanchal Services helper flickered out deep inside the duct and the spare lamp battery was also drained. He waited against the wall and guided himself out along the air line. Lamp-plus-spare check made a signed permit line item; two more EX-rated lamps procured for the GCS.

Morning walkdown found a bird nest inside an unused starter panel with the door slightly open. Panel kept switched off and the nest cleared by the electrician with the supply confirmed dead. Panel doors now checked for proper closing after every job.

During flare tip inspection preparation at GGS-4, rope access vendor's resume showed height medical expired for one technician. He was already kitted up at base of stack. Removed from job, replacement called. Medical fitness for height work is not paperwork only, a dizzy spell at 40 m is a fall. Vendor warned in writing through contract cell.

N2 purged vessel at Dumduma, night exit after gasket job. Stair from platform had its mid-rail removed for pipe lifting that afternoon and chain not refitted. Attendant descending first with arms full of blanks stepped toward the open gap, felt air where rail should be, stopped with his heart in his mouth. Chain refitted by torchlight, blanks carried down in two trips. Rails removed for lifting return before the lifter's truck leaves.
barrier: entry during night shift without lighting

text: Crane lifting pump skid at Kathalguri GCS, tag line was held by trainee alone. Skid swung towards live control panel, trainee could not control, panel door hit and dented. Panel was energized inside, glass meter broke. Two person tag line rule for loads above one tonne made, panel shifted away from lifting zone later, temporary barrier put during lifts. Electrician checked panel, no internal damage fortunately.

An employee was standing approximately 6-8 feet high on an A-frame ladder and cutting a tree limb using a power pruner. The employee threw the cut limb to the ground and it bounced, striking the ladder. The employee fell from the ladder and struck his head on the concrete ground. The employee sustained head trauma.
An employee had been unloading packages. His right middle fingertip was [OUTCOME] while he was opening a container on the castor deck.

Observation at GGS-2 heater area on 25.07.2025: fuel oil day tank outlet job planned but isolation sketch showed no vent point between the tank and the heater pump. Sketch corrected before starting and vent provided. Sketch review made compulsory by the issuer signature. Recorded as unsafe condition caught before the job.

On August 5, 2025, at approximately 8:35 AM, an employee was stubbing conduit onto a switchgear cabinet to install a bell end when they contacted a live component in the cabinet. The employee was shocked and sustained burns to their head, arms, and back, requiring [OUTCOME].

During calibration of demulsifier dosing pump at Kathalguri GCS, the calibration pot vent was found choked and pressure built when pump stroked. Pot glass tube shattered and pieces fell on the platform, narrowly missing the helper below. Pot was not in the energy source list so it was never depressurized during isolation. Pot added to isolation checklist same day.
One fellow sharpening pencil with blade near control desk. Gave him a sharpener, blade disposed safely.

Water tank overflowing behind the mess and a green algae patch spreading on the wall and floor. Overflow pipe extended to the drain and the patch scrubbed clean. Tank level now checked in the morning mess round.

Gas leak emergency mock drill conducted at Dumduma GGS on 25.08.2025 using a simulated scenario. SCBA donning practiced by four operators within time. One SCBA face strap found loose and adjusted by fire staff. Escape route wind sock found faded and replacement indented. Drill report submitted to fire section.

While on a scaffold, an employee was transporting heated sealant material in a bucket. The employee tripped and fell, causing the heated material to splash onto his gloved hands. The employee sustained [OUTCOME] to both hands and his right wrist.
An employee was fixing a shifting load that was being hoisted on a cable elevator when his gloved hand got caught in the wire rope, [OUTCOME] his right little fingertip.

Lighting transformer replacement at Digboi on 07.02.2025. HT drop-out fuse barrel would not seat properly. Lineman tapped it with the bakelite handle of his plier while holding the barrel by hand — line was being recharged at that moment from substation due to early closing by operator. Arc at barrel, he let go and barrel fell to ground. Time coordination now by both-side phone confirmation only, not clock time.

LOTO incomplete on PSV inlet isolation during oily water separator pit work at Moran GGS-1. PSV tail line vented near pit. During nearby vessel pressure buildup, PSV popped and vapour cloud drifted over pit where two workers were cleaning. They came out coughing, fortunately vapour was mostly steam side. PSV isolation added to pit entry permits.
activity: OWS pit cleaning near PSV vent

text: During slug catcher pit inspection at Naharkatiya GCS, helper saw snake coiled near pit ladder while descending. he panicked and climbed back fast, almost slipped on wet rung. pit cleared by snake catcher next day.

While pulling chain block to align pipe spool at Baghjan EPS on 15 September 2025, helper kept hand on chain near sprocket wheel and fingers almost drawn in when chain jumped. He removed hand just in time as mistri shouted. Hands in pinch point. Spool alignment continued with push rod. Incident shared in site WhatsApp safety group also.

A sanitation employee entered the chemical room and slipped on the wet floor. When he slipped, he kicked over a bucket containing cleaning chemicals. The chemicals splashed onto the employee's clothing and burned his skin.

On 04.05.2025 around 08:25 hrs, one pickup van went past the Duliajan township school zone with the driver's door not closed properly. Door swung open near the crossing and hit the crossing guard's umbrella stand. Umbrella fell on the road. Guard picked it up angrily. Door latch was defective and driver was holding the door with one hand and steering with other. Vehicle stopped at gate and door repaired. Holding door and steering together is not driving, told to the driver plainly.
